nodes.title: 时态总览
nodes.organizer: 英语用「时态」表示动作发生的时间。整张时态地图的主线是：先掌握 be 动词，再学一般现在时，然后逐步扩展到现在进行、过去、将来。你现在站在地图的起点。

explanation.text: 英语的时态 = 时间（过去 / 现在 / 将来）+ 方式（一般 / 进行 / 完成）。同一个动作站在不同的时间位置、用不同的方式描述，动词形态就不同。

items: I am a student.（be 动词·现在）
I work every day.（一般现在时）
I am working now.（现在进行时）
I worked yesterday.（一般过去时）
I will work tomorrow.（将来）

explanation.text: 比喻：把时间想象成一条河，时态就是站在河的不同位置描述同一件事——站在岸边看（一般时），跳进河里感受（进行时），回头看过留下的痕迹（完成时）。

activity.prompt: 用英语写一句你「现在正在做」的事，再写一句你「每天都会做」的事。
activity.sampleAnswer: I am learning English. / I drink coffee every morning.

questions.prompt: 英语时态主要用来表达什么？
options: 动作发生的时间与方式
questions.explanation: 时态 = 时间 + 方式，动词形态随两者变化。

questions.prompt: 下面哪句是「现在进行时」？
questions.explanation: am + doing 表示此刻正在进行。

questions.prompt: 下面哪句表示「过去发生的动作」？
questions.explanation: watched 是过去式，last night 也提示过去。

questions.prompt: 时态由「时间」和＿＿＿两个维度构成。（填一个词）
questions.explanation: 时间 × 方式，组合出各种时态。

nodes.title: be 动词现在时
nodes.organizer: be 动词（am / is / are）是英语最基础的「身份/状态」动词。它位于时态地图的第一站：掌握它，才能进入一般现在时和现在进行时。

explanation.text: 主语决定 be 动词的形式：I → am；he / she / it → is；you / we / they → are。否定在后面加 not；疑问把 be 动词提到主语前面。

items: I am happy.
She is a teacher.
They are students.
Is he your friend? — Yes, he is.
I am not tired.

explanation.text: 比喻：be 动词像一个「等号」，把主语和它的身份或状态连起来：I = a student。

activity.prompt: 用 be 动词写 3 句话介绍自己（名字 / 身份 / 心情）。
activity.sampleAnswer: I am Li Ming. I am a student. I am happy.

questions.prompt: She ___ my sister.
questions.explanation: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，用 is。

questions.prompt: They ___ from China.
下面哪句是一般疑问句？
questions.explanation: 把 be 动词提到主语前构成疑问句。

questions.prompt: 否定句：I ___ not at home.
questions.explanation: I 对应 am，否定直接加 am not。

nodes.title: 一般现在时
nodes.organizer: 一般现在时描述习惯、事实和长期状态，是时态地图的主干节点——掌握它才能解锁频率副词、一般过去时和将来表达。功能地图里的「日常作息」也靠它实现。

explanation.text: 结构：主语 + 动词原形。第三人称单数（he / she / it）动词加 -s / -es。否定和疑问借助 do / does，此时主动词用原形。

items: I drink coffee every morning.
He goes to work by bus.
Water boils at 100°C.
Do you like music?
She doesn't eat meat.

explanation.text: 比喻：一般现在时像「相机的默认模式」——拍下的是日常、恒定不变的画面。

activity.prompt: 写一句你的日常习惯，主语用第三人称，注意动词形式。
activity.sampleAnswer: My father watches TV after dinner.

questions.prompt: He ___ to school every day.
questions.explanation: 第三人称单数 + s → goes。

questions.prompt: She ___ like fish.
questions.explanation: she 对应 doesn't，后面动词用原形 like。

questions.prompt: 下面哪句是一般疑问句？
questions.explanation: 句首加 Do 构成一般疑问句。

questions.prompt: The sun ___ (rise) in the east.（填正确动词形式）
questions.explanation: the sun 是第三人称单数，rise 加 s。

nodes.title: 现在进行时
nodes.organizer: 现在进行时表示「此刻正在发生」的动作。它直接建立在 be 动词之上（am / is / are + doing），也可以表示近期的安排。

explanation.text: 结构：be 动词 + 动词-ing。常搭配 now、right now、at the moment、Look! / Listen! 等提示词。

items: I am reading a book now.
She is cooking dinner.
They are playing football.
Look! It is raining.
We are meeting friends tomorrow.（近期安排）

explanation.text: 比喻：一般现在时是一张「照片」，现在进行时是一段「录像」——画面正在播放中。

activity.prompt: 写一句你此刻正在做的事，句末加上 right now。
activity.sampleAnswer: I am writing a note right now.

questions.prompt: They ___ football now.
Listen! The baby ___.
questions.explanation: Listen! 表示此刻正在发生。

questions.prompt: 下面哪句结构正确？
questions.explanation: 进行时 = be 动词 + doing，缺一不可。

questions.prompt: I ___ (work) on my homework right now.（填进行时）

nodes.title: 一般过去时
nodes.organizer: 一般过去时描述过去发生的事，是「回头看」的时态。掌握它之后，可以继续解锁过去进行时和现在完成时入门。

explanation.text: 规则动词加 -ed；不规则动词需要记忆（go → went、see → saw）。否定和疑问用 did，此时主动词还原为原形。

items: I watched a movie last night.
She went to Beijing in 2020.
We didn't know the answer.
Did you call me yesterday?

explanation.text: 比喻：过去时是「存档回放」——事情已经打完，现在回看录像。

activity.prompt: 写一句你上周末做过的事，用过去时。
activity.sampleAnswer: I visited my grandparents last weekend.

questions.prompt: He ___ to the park yesterday.
questions.explanation: go 的过去式是不规则的 went。

questions.prompt: I ___ TV last night.（否定句）
questions.explanation: did 后面用动词原形 watch。

questions.prompt: ___ you see the film?
questions.explanation: 过去时疑问句句首用 Did。

questions.prompt: She ___ (buy) a new phone last week.（填过去式）
questions.explanation: buy 是不规则动词，过去式 bought。

nodes.title: 将来表达
nodes.organizer: 将来最常用的表达是 be going to（计划）和 will（临时决定 / 预测）。它们站在一般现在时的肩膀上描述未来。

explanation.text: be going to 表示事先计划好的事；will 表示说话时的临时决定或对将来的预测。常搭配 tomorrow、next week、soon。

items: I am going to visit Japan next month.（计划）
It will rain tomorrow.（预测）
I'll help you.（临时决定）
We are going to move house.

explanation.text: 比喻：going to 是「买好票的旅行」，will 是「说走就走的旅行」。

activity.prompt: 写一句你下周的计划，用 be going to 或 will。
activity.sampleAnswer: I am going to start a new book next week.

questions.prompt: Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
questions.explanation: 有迹象的预测用 be going to。

questions.prompt: — The phone is ringing. — I ___ answer it.（临时决定）
questions.explanation: 说话时临时决定用 will。

questions.prompt: She ___ study abroad next year.（早已定好的计划）
questions.explanation: 事先计划用 be going to。

questions.prompt: I ___ call you tonight.（临时决定，填 will / 'll 之一）
questions.explanation: 临时决定用 will，缩写 I'll 也对。

nodes.title: 过去进行时
nodes.organizer: 过去进行时描述「过去某一刻正在发生」的动作：was / were + doing。它是过去时家族的「录像模式」。

explanation.text: was 用于 I / he / she / it，were 用于 you / we / they。常搭配 at 8 last night、when... 等时间背景。

items: I was watching TV at 8 last night.
They were playing outside when it started to rain.
She wasn't sleeping at that time.

explanation.text: 比喻：一般过去时是一张旧照片，过去进行时是旧录像里的某一帧——它给你「背景画面」，常与插入的短动作连用。

activity.prompt: 写一句「昨晚八点你正在做的事」。
activity.sampleAnswer: I was having dinner at 8 last night.

questions.prompt: I ___ dinner when you called.
questions.explanation: 「你打电话时正在做饭」→ was cooking。

questions.prompt: They ___ football at 5 p.m. yesterday.
下面哪句否定形式正确？
He ___ (sleep) when I arrived.（填过去进行时）

nodes.title: 现在完成时入门
nodes.organizer: 现在完成时（have / has + 过去分词）连接过去与现在，最典型的用法是描述「经历」。这是 A2 末期的入门节点。

explanation.text: 结构：have / has + 过去分词。两大入门用法：① 描述经历（I have been to...）；② 过去动作对现在的影响（I have lost my key → 现在还没找到）。

items: I have been to London twice.
She has finished her homework.
Have you ever eaten sushi?
He has lost his keys.

explanation.text: 比喻：完成时像一本「账本」——记的是过去的账，看的是现在的余额。

activity.prompt: 用 have / has been to 写一句你的旅行经历。
activity.sampleAnswer: I have been to Shanghai three times.

questions.prompt: I ___ to Japan twice.
She ___ her homework already.
questions.explanation: already 是完成时标志词，she → has。

questions.prompt: 下面哪句是疑问句？
questions.explanation: Have 提前构成完成时疑问句。

questions.prompt: He ___ (lose) his phone.（完成时：现在还没找到）
questions.explanation: he → has + lose 的过去分词 lost。

nodes.title: 现在完成进行时
nodes.organizer: 完成时与进行时的合体：have been doing。它强调「动作从过去一直持续到现在」——账本还在记，笔还没停。

explanation.text: 结构 have / has been + V-ing。强调持续与近期影响：I have been waiting for two hours. 常与 for、since、lately、all day 连用。

items: I have been learning English for six years.
She has been working here since May.
It has been raining all day.
Have you been waiting long?

explanation.text: 比喻：完成时是「账本」，完成进行时是「还在记的账本」——重点是过程仍在延续。

activity.prompt: 写一句你坚持了很久的事情（用 for 或 since）。
activity.sampleAnswer: I have been playing the piano for eight years.

questions.prompt: How long have you ___ this book?
She ___ all morning — that's why the kitchen smells great.
哪句强调「动作持续到现在」？
options: I have been reading the book all afternoon.
questions.explanation: 完成进行时强调持续的过程。

questions.prompt: They ___ (wait) for the bus for half an hour.

nodes.title: 过去完成时
nodes.organizer: 「过去的过去」：had + 过去分词。讲过去的两件事时，先发生的那件用过去完成时——在时间轴上再往左退一格。

explanation.text: had + V3，表过去某时刻之前已完成：When we arrived, the film had already started. 常与 before、after、already、by the time 连用。

items: The train had left when we got to the station.
She had finished dinner before I arrived.
I didn't recognize him because he had changed so much.
By 2010, they had moved to Berlin.

explanation.text: 比喻：过去完成时是「回忆里的回忆」——你在回忆昨天，还要再往前翻一页。

activity.prompt: 用 when 或 before 写一句「到达时某事已发生」。
activity.sampleAnswer: When I got to the platform, the bus had already gone.

questions.prompt: When we arrived, the match ___ already ___.
questions.explanation: 过去之前发生 → had started。

questions.prompt: She was sad because she ___ her exam.
___ he got home, his wife had cooked dinner.
questions.explanation: By the time + 过去式，主句过去完成。

questions.prompt: I ___ (never / see) the sea before that trip.
questions.explanation: before that trip 提示过去的过去。

nodes.title: 将来进行时
nodes.organizer: 未来某个时刻「正在发生」：will be doing。像给未来装一台监控摄像头，拍下那一刻的画面。

explanation.text: will be + V-ing：This time tomorrow I will be flying to Rome. 表未来某刻正在进行；询问安排时比 will do 更委婉。

items: Don't call at 8 — I will be having dinner.
This time next week we will be lying on the beach.
Will you be using the car tonight?
She will be sleeping when you land.

explanation.text: Will you be doing? 比 Will you do? 更礼貌——像在问「行程表上写了什么」而不是「你愿不愿意」。

activity.prompt: 写一句「下周的这个时候你正在做什么」。
activity.sampleAnswer: This time next Sunday I will be hiking in the mountains.

questions.prompt: This time tomorrow I ___ to Paris.
哪句更礼貌地询问对方安排？
options: Will you come to the party?
Will you be coming to the party?
questions.explanation: will be doing 委婉询问安排。

questions.prompt: At 10 pm tonight, they ___ the project.
Don't phone at nine — we ___ (have) dinner.

nodes.title: 基本语序
nodes.organizer: 英语句子的基本骨架是主谓宾：谁（主语）+ 做什么（动词）+ 对谁/什么（宾语）。它是所有句型的起点。

explanation.text: 陈述句基本顺序：主语 + 动词 + 宾语/补充。否定用助动词，疑问把助动词提前。

items: I like music.
She reads books.
They play football.
We don't speak French.

explanation.text: 比喻：语序像搭积木的顺序——先把「谁」放最前面，再放「动作」，最后放「对象」。

activity.prompt: 写一个主谓宾结构的句子，描述你喜欢的一件事物。
activity.sampleAnswer: I like coffee.

questions.prompt: 下面哪句是正确的主谓宾语序？
questions.explanation: 主语 + 动词 + 宾语。

questions.prompt: She ___ books every day.
「I drink water.」中哪个词是宾语？
questions.explanation: water 是动作 drink 的对象。

questions.prompt: 「I ___ (like) music.」填动词正确形式。
questions.explanation: 主语 I 用动词原形。

nodes.title: be 句型
nodes.organizer: be 句型是最基础的句子：用 am/is/are 表达身份、状态和存在。它是「be 动词现在时」节点的直接应用。

explanation.text: 肯定：I am / He is / They are + 名词或形容词。否定加 not；疑问把 be 提前。

items: I am a student.
She is happy.
They are at home.
Are you ready? — Yes, I am.

explanation.text: be 句型 = 「等号句」，把主语和它的身份/状态用 be 连起来。

activity.prompt: 用 be 动词写一句肯定句和一句疑问句。
activity.sampleAnswer: He is a doctor. / Is he a doctor?

questions.prompt: He ___ a teacher.
哪句是否定句？
___ they at home?
questions.explanation: they 对应 are，疑问提前。

questions.prompt: This ___ (be) my book.

nodes.title: 一般疑问句
nodes.organizer: 一般疑问句用 Yes/No 回答。核心规则：把 be 或助动词提到主语前面。

explanation.text: be 句型：提前 be。行为动词：句首加 Do / Does / Did，主动词还原为原形。

items: Are you a student?
Do you like tea?
Does she work here?
Did you call me?

explanation.text: 把陈述句变成「是非题」——回答只需要 Yes 或 No。

activity.prompt: 把一个陈述句改写成一般疑问句，并自己回答。
activity.sampleAnswer: You like tea. → Do you like tea? — Yes, I do.

questions.prompt: You like tea. 改成疑问句是？
She is a doctor. 改成疑问句是？
___ you speak English?（Do / Does / Did）
___ she like coffee?（Does）

nodes.title: Wh- 问句
nodes.organizer: Wh- 问句用 what/where/who/when/why/how 开头，获取具体信息，而不是只回答是/否。

explanation.text: 结构：Wh- 词 + 助动词/be + 主语 + 动词。回答给出具体信息。

items: What do you do?
Where are you from?
Who is she?
When is your birthday?

explanation.text: Wh- 词是「信息探测器」——每个词问一类信息：what 问事物，where 问地点，who 问人。

activity.prompt: 用 what 和 where 各写一个问句。
activity.sampleAnswer: What do you do? / Where do you live?

questions.prompt: ___ is your name?（问名字）
___ are you from?（问来自哪里）
___ is that girl? — She is my sister.
___ old are you?（How）

nodes.title: 并列与连接词
nodes.organizer: 用 and（并列）、but（转折）、because（原因）把简单句连成复合句，表达更丰富。

explanation.text: and 连接并列；but 表对比转折；because 引导原因。

items: I like tea and coffee.
He is young but smart.
I stay home because it rains.
She sings and dances.

explanation.text: and 是「加法」，but 是「转折」，because 是「原因」。

activity.prompt: 用 and / but / because 各写一个句子。
activity.sampleAnswer: I like tea and coffee. / He is young but smart. / I left early because I was sick.

questions.prompt: 表达转折用哪个？
I'm tired ___ happy.（又累又开心）
questions.explanation: 累与开心是转折对比，用 but。

questions.prompt: I left early ___ I was sick.（原因）
She likes music ___ art.（并列，and）

nodes.title: 命令句（祈使句）
nodes.organizer: 祈使句用来下命令、给建议或指示，主语省略，动词原形开头。指路、做菜都用它。

explanation.text: 肯定：动词原形开头。否定：Don't + 动词原形。

items: Sit down.
Open the door.
Don't touch it.
Please be quiet.

explanation.text: 祈使句像「按钮指令」——直接用动词原形下达，不带主语。

activity.prompt: 写一句给别人指路的祈使句。
activity.sampleAnswer: Go straight and turn left.

questions.prompt: 「坐下」怎么说？
questions.explanation: 祈使句动词原形开头，无主语。

questions.prompt: 否定祈使句用哪个开头？
___ the door, please.（开门）
___ (Don't / Not) run in the hallway.

nodes.title: 条件句
nodes.organizer: 条件句用 if 表达「如果…就…」。零条件句讲普遍事实，第一条件句讲将来可能的结果。它位于句型结构的末端，需要一般现在时的基础。

explanation.text: 零条件句：If + 一般现在时, 一般现在时（If it rains, the ground gets wet.）。第一条件句：If + 一般现在时, will + 动词原形（If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.）。

items: If you heat ice, it melts.（零条件·事实）
If it rains, I stay home.（零条件·习惯）
If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.（第一条件）
If you study hard, you will pass.

explanation.text: 零条件 = 「总是如此」的规律；第一条件 = 「将来的可能性」。

activity.prompt: 用第一条件句写一句「如果你…你就会…」。
activity.sampleAnswer: If I have time, I will call you.

questions.prompt: 零条件句表达什么？
questions.explanation: 零条件句讲的是总是成立的规律。

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, I ___ at home.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句用 will + 原形。

questions.prompt: If you ___ ice, it melts.
questions.explanation: 零条件句主句从句都用一般现在时。

questions.prompt: If I have time, I ___ help you.（第一条件句的助动词）
questions.explanation: 第一条件句从句一般现在时，主句 will + 原形。

nodes.title: 过去习惯：used to / would
nodes.organizer: 「以前常…现在不了」：used to do / would do。给回忆加上「过去滤镜」。

explanation.text: used to + 原形（过去的习惯或状态，现在已不）：I used to live in Chengdu。would + 原形（只表过去的反复动作，不表状态）：Every summer we would go to the lake。

items: I used to hate coffee, but now I love it.
There used to be a cinema here.
On Sundays, grandma would bake bread.
He didn't use to exercise.

explanation.text: 「曾是」的状态只能用 used to：✗ would be a teacher → ✓ used to be a teacher。

activity.prompt: 写两句你童年的习惯（一句 used to，一句 would）。
activity.sampleAnswer: I used to be afraid of dogs; every summer we would visit my grandparents.

questions.prompt: I ___ to eat spicy food, but now I love it.
On winter evenings, dad ___ tell us stories.
questions.explanation: 反复动作 → would + 原形。

questions.prompt: 哪句正确表达「她以前是老师」？
options: She used to be a teacher.
She used to being a teacher.

questions.prompt: There ___ (use) to be a bookstore on this corner.
questions.explanation: used to be 过去存在。

nodes.title: 动名词与不定式的意义差
nodes.organizer: remember / stop / try + to do 与 + doing 意思大不同：一个是「先想起来再做」，一个是「换一种尝试」。B2 的精度分水岭。

explanation.text: remember to do（记得要去做）vs remember doing（记得做过）；stop to do（停下来去做）vs stop doing（停止做）；try to do（努力做）vs try doing（试试做）；regret to do（遗憾地告知）vs regret doing（后悔做过）。

items: Did you remember to lock the door?
I remember locking the door.
He stopped to take a photo.
He stopped smoking last year.

explanation.text: to do 多指向「未发生的事」，doing 指向「已发生的事」——先判断时间方向再选形式。

activity.prompt: 用 remember 的两种形式各写一句。
activity.sampleAnswer: Remember to water the plants; I remember visiting that museum.

questions.prompt: On the way home, remember ___ some milk.
I'll never forget ___ the Alps for the first time.
He stopped ___ a coffee because he was sleepy.
questions.explanation: 停下来去做另一件事 → to do。

questions.prompt: Try ___ (restart) the router — that often works.

nodes.title: 强调句
nodes.organizer: 把句子的任一部分推到聚光灯下：It was Anna who called / What I need is time。英语的「重音」可以靠结构实现。

explanation.text: It + be + 强调部分 + that / who…；What + 句子 + is / was…；All (that) I want is…；The reason why… is…

items: It was the noise that woke me.
What surprises me is the price.
All I need is one more chance.
The reason I called is to apologize.

explanation.text: 检验方法：去掉 It was… that，句子依然成立，这就是强调句。

activity.prompt: 用 What… is… 强调你最需要的东西。
activity.sampleAnswer: What I really need is a good night's sleep.

questions.prompt: ___ was the weather that ruined our picnic.
___ I like most about her is her honesty.
哪句强调了「时间」？
options: It was in 2019 that I met her.

questions.prompt: The reason ___ he resigned is still unclear.

nodes.title: 省略与替代
nodes.organizer: 高级口笔语的「留白术」：把可推知的成分省掉（ellipsis），或用 do / so / one 代换（substitution），让语言紧凑老练。

explanation.text: 省略：She can speak French, and he can (too)；替代：I will come if you do；Would you like one?；So / Neither + 助动词 + 主语（我也是 / 我也不）。

items: "Will you join us?" — "I would love to."
She works night shifts and so does her husband.
I don't eat meat, and neither does he.
"I have finished." — "So have I."

explanation.text: So / Neither + 助动词 + 主语 = 「我也是 / 我也不」——助动词要与前面句子的时态一致。

activity.prompt: 用 So do I / Neither do I 回应两句描述自己的话。
activity.sampleAnswer: I love hiking. — So do I. I never drink coffee. — Neither do I.

questions.prompt: "I have never been to Iceland." — "___."
She enjoys jazz, and ___ her sister.
questions.explanation: 第三人称单数 → so does。

questions.prompt: "Would you like another cup?" — "___."
"I am exhausted." — "So ___ I."

nodes.title: 单数/复数名词
nodes.organizer: 名词分单数和复数。复数通常加 -s/-es，也有一些不规则变化。

explanation.text: 规则：加 -s（books）；以 s/x/ch/sh 加 -es（boxes）；辅音+y 变 ies（cities）；不规则（man→men, child→children）。

items: one book → two books
one box → two boxes
one city → two cities
one child → three children

explanation.text: 复数像「给名词加尾巴」，大多数加 s，个别要变形。

activity.prompt: 写出下列单词的复数：apple, watch, baby
activity.sampleAnswer: apples, watches, babies

questions.prompt: apple 的复数是？
box 的复数是？
questions.explanation: 以 x 结尾加 es。

questions.prompt: child 的复数是？
one baby → two ___

nodes.title: 可数/不可数名词
nodes.organizer: 名词分可数与不可数：可数能数个数，不可数（水、面包、钱）不能用 one/two 数。

explanation.text: 可数：apple, book（有单复数）。不可数：water, rice, money（无复数，不加 a/an）。

items: an apple（可数）
some water（不可数）
three books（可数）
some money（不可数）

explanation.text: 能「一个一个数」的是可数；水、米、钱这类「数不清」的是不可数。

activity.prompt: 判断 water / book / music / pen 哪些可数。
activity.sampleAnswer: book 和 pen 可数，water 和 music 不可数。

questions.prompt: 哪个是不可数名词？
money 前面能不能用 a？
哪个是可数名词？
___ apple（a / an）
questions.explanation: apple 以元音音素开头用 an。

nodes.title: 冠词 a/an/the
nodes.organizer: 冠词 a/an 表泛指一个，the 表特指。a 用于辅音音素，an 用于元音音素。

explanation.text: a + 辅音音素开头（a book）；an + 元音音素开头（an apple, an hour）。the 表示双方都知道的那个或独一无二的事物。

items: a book, a pen
an apple, an hour
the sun（独一无二）
I have a dog. The dog is white.

explanation.text: a/an 是「一个」的泛指，the 是「那个」的特指。

activity.prompt: 在下列名词前填 a 或 an：apple, car, orange, hour
activity.sampleAnswer: an apple, a car, an orange, an hour

questions.prompt: ___ apple（选冠词）
questions.explanation: apple 元音音素开头用 an。

questions.prompt: ___ university（注意发音）
questions.explanation: university 发 /juː/，辅音音素开头用 a。

questions.prompt: the sun 用 the 是因为？
I saw ___ elephant.（a / an）

nodes.title: There be 结构
nodes.organizer: There is/are 表示「某处有某物」，是描述存在的高频句型。

explanation.text: There is + 单数/不可数；There are + 复数。疑问把 be 提前，否定加 not。

items: There is a book on the desk.
There are three chairs.
Is there a park nearby?
There isn't any milk.

explanation.text: There be 是「存在探测器」——专门回答「那里有什么」。

activity.prompt: 用 There is / There are 描述你的房间。
activity.sampleAnswer: There is a bed and there are two chairs in my room.

questions.prompt: ___ a pen on the table.
___ two cats in the garden.
否定形式是？
There ___ (is/are) some milk.

nodes.title: 数量词
nodes.organizer: some / any / much / many / a lot of 表示数量：some 用于肯定，any 用于否定和疑问；much 接不可数，many 接可数。

explanation.text: some / any：肯定句用 some，否定句和疑问句用 any。many + 可数复数，much + 不可数，a lot of 两者皆可。

items: I have some money.
Do you have any questions?
There isn't much water.
How many books do you have?
She has a lot of friends.

explanation.text: 判断用 much 还是 many：能数出个数用 many，数不出用 much。

activity.prompt: 用 some 和 any 各写一句。
activity.sampleAnswer: I have some money. / Do you have any questions?

questions.prompt: ___ water（不可数，大量用）
How ___ apples do you want?
Do you have ___ questions?
I have ___ money.（肯定句）

nodes.title: 形容词顺序
nodes.organizer: 多个形容词修饰名词时有约定顺序：观点→大小→年龄→颜色→来源→材料。扩展名词短语时遵循这条「排位规则」。

explanation.text: 常见顺序：opinion（nice）→ size（big）→ age（old）→ color（red）→ material（wooden）。口语中一般不超过 3 个形容词。

items: a big red ball
a beautiful old house
a small black leather bag
an interesting new book

explanation.text: 「好看的大红木球」= 观点 → 大小 → 颜色 → 材料，形容词像排队进场，顺序有讲究。

activity.prompt: 用 2 个形容词写一个名词短语。
activity.sampleAnswer: a small black bag

questions.prompt: 正确的形容词顺序是？
questions.explanation: 大小在颜色之前：big red ball。

questions.prompt: 属于 opinion（观点）类的形容词是？
questions.explanation: nice 是观点，big 是大小，red 是颜色，wooden 是材料。

questions.prompt: 下列哪个通常放得最靠后？
questions.explanation: 材料类形容词最接近名词。

questions.prompt: a ___ (new / interesting) book（观点类放前面）
questions.explanation: 观点类形容词在年龄类之前。

nodes.title: 比较级与最高级
nodes.organizer: 比较级（bigger）用于两者比较，最高级（biggest）用于三者以上。短词加 -er / -est，长词用 more / most。

explanation.text: 短词：big → bigger → biggest；长词：interesting → more interesting → most interesting；不规则：good → better → best。

items: My bag is bigger than yours.
She is taller than me.
This is the most interesting book.
He is the best player.

explanation.text: 两者比用「比较级 + than」，三者以上用「the + 最高级」。

activity.prompt: 用比较级写一句比较你和朋友的句子。
activity.sampleAnswer: I am taller than my friend.

questions.prompt: big 的比较级是？
interesting 的最高级是？
good 的最高级是？
questions.explanation: good 是不规则变化：good → better → best。

questions.prompt: She is ___ (tall) than her sister.（比较级）

nodes.title: 人称代词
nodes.organizer: 人称代词分主格（I/you/he/she/it/we/they）和宾格（me/you/him/her/it/us/them）。主格做主语，宾格做宾语。

explanation.text: 主格在动词前做主语；宾格在动词/介词后做宾语。

items: I like it.
She helps him.
Give me the book.
We see them.

explanation.text: 主格是「出手的人」，宾格是「被作用的人」。

activity.prompt: 用人称代词改写：Maria → she
activity.sampleAnswer: Maria is my friend. → She is my friend.

questions.prompt: ___ is my friend.（他）
I like ___（她，宾格）
They help ___（我们，宾格）
___ (I) am a student.（主格）

nodes.title: 物主限定词
nodes.organizer: 物主限定词（my/your/his/her/its/our/their）表示「谁的」，放在名词前。

explanation.text: my book, your name, his car, her bag, our house, their dog。注意 his/its 主格宾格同形。

items: This is my book.
What's your name?
Her hair is long.
Our school is big.

explanation.text: 物主限定词是「贴在名词上的标签」，标明归属。

activity.prompt: 用 my / your / his 各写一个短语。
activity.sampleAnswer: my phone, your book, his car

questions.prompt: ___ name is Tom.（我的）
This is ___ bag.（她的）
___ car is new.（他们的）
___ (I) favorite color is blue.（物主限定词）

nodes.title: 指示代词
nodes.organizer: this/these 指近处，that/those 指远处。this/that 单数，these/those 复数。

explanation.text: this（这个）/that（那个）接单数；these（这些）/those（那些）接复数。

items: This is a pen.
That is a tree.
These are my books.
Those are stars.

explanation.text: 近处用 this/these，远处用 that/those。

activity.prompt: 用 this / these 各写一句描述近处的东西。
activity.sampleAnswer: This is my desk. / These are my keys.

questions.prompt: 「这些」是？
This ___ a cat.
Those ___ my friends.
___ (That / Those) is my car.

nodes.title: can / can't
nodes.organizer: can 表示能力或许可，can't 表示不能。can 后接动词原形，所有人称不变形。

explanation.text: I can swim. / She can't dance. 疑问：Can you...? 回答 Yes, I can / No, I can't。

items: I can swim.
She can't dance.
Can you help me? — Sure.
They can speak English.

explanation.text: can 是「能力开关」——后面永远跟动词原形。

activity.prompt: 写一句你会做的事和一句你不会做的事。
activity.sampleAnswer: I can swim. / I can't play the piano.

questions.prompt: He ___ play the piano.（会弹）
questions.explanation: can 后接动词原形，不加 s。

questions.prompt: 「我不会游泳」怎么说？
疑问句：___ you cook?
She ___ (can/can't) drive a car.（否定）

nodes.title: must / have to / should
nodes.organizer: must / have to 表示义务（必须），should 表示建议（应该）。它们和 can 一样，后面接动词原形。

explanation.text: must 语气最强（必须），have to 是客观需要，should 是建议。否定：mustn't（禁止）、don't have to（不必）、shouldn't（不该）。

items: You must wear a seatbelt.
I have to go to work.
You should drink more water.
You shouldn't be late.

explanation.text: must 是「硬性规定」，should 是「温柔建议」。

activity.prompt: 用 must 和 should 各写一句。
activity.sampleAnswer: You must finish your homework. / You should rest more.

questions.prompt: 「你必须交作业」的正确说法是？
options: You must hand in your homework.
You should hand in your homework.
You can hand in your homework.

questions.prompt: 表示「不必」用哪个？
questions.explanation: don't have to 表示「不必」，mustn't 是「禁止」。

questions.prompt: 建议别人多休息：You ___ rest more.
You ___ not smoke here.（禁止，must 的否定）

nodes.title: 动词模式
nodes.organizer: 动词后面接什么形式有固定搭配：like doing / enjoy doing / want to do / decide to do，这是动词模式的核心。

explanation.text: like / enjoy / finish + doing；want / decide / hope + to do；有些动词两者皆可（like to do / like doing）。

items: I like reading books.
She enjoys listening to music.
I want to travel.
He decided to leave.

explanation.text: 记一个简单规律：enjoy / like 后面接 -ing，want / decide 后面接 to do。

activity.prompt: 用 want to do 和 enjoy doing 各写一句。
activity.sampleAnswer: I want to learn English. / I enjoy watching movies.

questions.prompt: She enjoys ___ music.
I want ___ a doctor.
He decided ___ early.
I like ___ (swim) in summer.（-ing 形式）

nodes.title: 推测情态
nodes.organizer: 用 must / might / can't 给判断「标定置信度」：must be（一定是）、might be（可能是）、can't be（不可能是）。

explanation.text: must / can't + 原形 表有把握的推测（依据明显）；might / could / may + 原形 表不确定。否定推测用 can't（不用 mustn't 表示「不可能」）。

items: The lights are on — they must be home.
You've been up all night; you must be exhausted.
He might be stuck in traffic.
It can't be true — she told me herself.

explanation.text: mustn't 是「禁止」，can't 才是「不可能是」——中文都会说「不可能」，英语分家。

activity.prompt: 看到邻居搬箱子上楼，写两句推测。
activity.sampleAnswer: They must be moving in; she might need a hand.

questions.prompt: She's yawning — she ___ be tired.
That ___ be Tom — Tom is in Berlin!
"Who is knocking?" — "It ___ be the courier; I am not sure."
You have worked 12 hours — you ___ be starving.（一定是）

nodes.title: 情态动词 + have done
nodes.organizer: 给「过去的判断 / 遗憾 / 责备」定调：must have done（当时一定）、should have done（本该）、can't have done（不可能）。全靠 have done 把情态搬进过去。

explanation.text: must / may / might / could / can't + have + V3 表对过去的推测；should / ought to have + V3 表本该未做；needn't have done 表做了却不必要。

items: The ground is wet — it must have rained.
She should have called ahead.
He can't have finished already!
You needn't have hurried; we are early.

explanation.text: shouldn't have done = 做了且不该；needn't have done = 做了但不必。一字之差，语气全变。

activity.prompt: 写一句对朋友迟到的推测（must / might）+ 一句建议（should have）。
activity.sampleAnswer: He might have missed the bus; he should have left earlier.

questions.prompt: The lights are off — they ___ have gone to bed.
questions.explanation: 对过去的肯定推测 → must have done。

questions.prompt: I'm sorry — I ___ have phoned you earlier.
questions.explanation: 本该未做 → should have done。

questions.prompt: She ___ have passed — the exam was impossible!
questions.explanation: 对过去的否定推测 → couldn't have done。

questions.prompt: You ___ have brought food — we had plenty.（不必却做了）

nodes.title: 地点介词
nodes.organizer: 地点介词描述位置：in（在…里）、on（在…上）、under（在…下）、next to（在…旁边）。

explanation.text: in the box, on the desk, under the chair, next to the bank。

items: The book is on the desk.
The cat is under the table.
She is next to me.
He is in the room.

explanation.text: 地点介词是「位置标签」，标出物体和参照物的空间关系。

activity.prompt: 用 in / on / under / next to 各描述一个物品的位置。
activity.sampleAnswer: The pen is on the desk. The cat is under the bed.

questions.prompt: 「在盒子里面」用哪个？
The cat is ___ the table.（在桌子下）
The bank is ___ the park.（在公园旁）
The book is ___ (on/in) the desk.

nodes.title: 时间介词
nodes.organizer: 时间介词：at 用于具体时刻，on 用于具体某天，in 用于月份/年份/时段。

explanation.text: at 7 o'clock, at noon; on Monday, on May 1st; in May, in 2025, in the morning。

items: I get up at 7.
We meet on Monday.
She was born in May.
He works in the morning.

explanation.text: 时刻用 at、日子用 on、月份年份用 in——由细到粗。

activity.prompt: 用 at / on / in 各写一个时间短语。
activity.sampleAnswer: at 7 o'clock, on Monday, in May

questions.prompt: ___ 7 o'clock（具体时刻）
___ Monday（具体某天）
___ May（月份）
I go to bed ___ (at/on) 11 p.m.

nodes.title: 转述陈述句
nodes.organizer: 把别人的话「打包转述」：He said (that) he was tired。时态往回退一步——因为你是站在现在转述过去的话。

explanation.text: said (that) + 从句；时态后移（present → past，past → 过去完成）；人称与时间词相应调整（tomorrow → the next day）。仍然客观真实现状可不后移。

items: 'I am busy.' → She said (that) she was busy.
'We will call you.' → They said they would call me.
'I finished it.' → He said he had finished it.
'I like tea.' → She said she liked tea.（现状也可不改：She said she likes tea.）

explanation.text: 比喻：转述像「复印件」——比原件「旧」一步（时态回退），内容一致。

activity.prompt: 转述朋友昨晚说过的一句话。
activity.sampleAnswer: My friend said (that) he was too tired to go out.

questions.prompt: 'I am tired.' → He said he ___ tired.
'We will help.' → They said they ___ help.
'I saw her yesterday.' → He said he had seen her ___.
'I like jazz.' → She said she ___ jazz.

nodes.title: 转述疑问句
nodes.organizer: 转述疑问句的关键：把疑问句「拉直」成陈述语序。ask + if/whether 或 ask + 疑问词，不再倒装、不再保留助动词 do。

explanation.text: Yes/No 问题 → asked if / whether + 陈述语序；wh- 问题 → asked + 疑问词 + 陈述语序；时态照常后移。

items: 'Are you ready?' → She asked if I was ready.
'Where do you live?' → He asked where I lived.
'What time does it start?' → She asked what time it started.
'Have you seen it?' → They asked whether I had seen it.

explanation.text: 常见错误：He asked where did I live ✗ → 疑问词后面直接「主语 + 动词」，把问号拉直。

activity.prompt: 转述别人问过你的一个问题。
activity.sampleAnswer: My teacher asked where I had learned English.

questions.prompt: 'Where are you from?' → She asked where I ___ from.
questions.explanation: 陈述语序 + 时态回退。

questions.prompt: 'Do you speak French?' → He asked ___ I spoke French.
哪句转述语序正确？
options: He asked what time was it.
He asked what time it was.
He asked what time did it was.
He asked what was it time.

questions.prompt: 'What do you want?' → He asked what I ___.

nodes.title: 报告动词与转述语气
nodes.organizer: 别再满嘴 said / asked：admit、claim、warn、suggest 各自带不同的「转述姿态」。C1 的转述在于精准与多样。

explanation.text: 报告动词句型：+ that（admit / claim / deny / warn）；+ V-ing（suggest / deny / admit）；+ 宾语 + to do（advise / encourage / remind / warn）；+ to do（promise / refuse / offer / threaten）。

items: She admitted (that) she had made a mistake.
He suggested going by train.
They reminded me to bring my passport.
I promised to be on time.

explanation.text: suggest 后面不接 to do（✗ suggest to go）——记搭配比记翻译更重要。

activity.prompt: 用 admit、remind、suggest 各写一句转述。
activity.sampleAnswer: She admitted breaking the vase; he reminded me to lock up; I suggest leaving early.

questions.prompt: He ___ to help me with the boxes.
questions.explanation: offer to do sth 主动提出。

questions.prompt: She ___ me to take an umbrella.
哪句正确？
She ___ (admit 的过去式) that she was wrong.

nodes.title: 基本被动语态
nodes.organizer: 把「谁做的」藏起来、突出「什么发生了」：be + 过去分词。英语新闻和说明文的常用声线。

explanation.text: 各时态的被动 = 该时态的 be + V3：is made / was built / will be sent。by 短语引出执行者（需要时才说）。

items: This bridge was built in 1890.
English is spoken here.
The parcel will be delivered tomorrow.
My phone was stolen last night.

explanation.text: 比喻：主动句是「我推了门」，被动句把镜头对准门——「门被推开了」，推的人可以不出镜。

activity.prompt: 写一句描述你家某件物品的来历（用被动）。
activity.sampleAnswer: This table was made by my grandfather.

questions.prompt: Paper ___ by the Chinese over 2,000 years ago.
The room ___ every day.
questions.explanation: 一般现在被动 is + V3。

questions.prompt: 哪句是被动语态？
Rice ___ (grow) in the south.（一般现在被动）

nodes.title: 被动语态进阶
nodes.organizer: 被动不止 was done：进行 / 完成 / 情态都能披上被动外衣——is being done, has been done, must be done。

explanation.text: 进行被动 is / are being done；完成被动 has / have been done；情态被动 must / can / should be done；不定式被动 to be done。

items: The road is being repaired.
The email has already been sent.
Tickets must be bought in advance.
He hates being interrupted.

explanation.text: 识别诀窍：看到 be 的各种「变身」（being / been）跟在助动词后，多半是被动的接力。

activity.prompt: 描述一件你所在城市正在进行的改造（用进行被动）。
activity.sampleAnswer: The old park is being turned into a plaza.

questions.prompt: Listen! A new hospital ___ next to the school.
questions.explanation: 进行被动 is being built。

questions.prompt: The report ___ by Friday.
My laptop ___ stolen — it's gone!
questions.explanation: 完成被动 has been + V3。

questions.prompt: The problem ___ (already / solve).（完成被动）

nodes.title: 使役结构 have / get
nodes.organizer: 不亲自动手，而是「安排别人做」：have / get something done。被动思维的社交版——服务、委托、遭遇，一句话说完。

explanation.text: have / get + 宾语 + V3（I had my hair cut）；have + 人 + do（让某人做）；get + 人 + to do；被动义变体：She had her bag stolen（遭遇）。

items: I get my car serviced twice a year.
She had her laptop repaired.
We had the walls painted white.
He got his phone stolen on the bus.

explanation.text: have sth done ≠ 自己做：I repaired the car（我修的）vs I had the car repaired（我找人修的）。

activity.prompt: 描述你最近一次「请人做」的事。
activity.sampleAnswer: I had my eyes tested last week.

questions.prompt: I need to ___ my photo ___ for the visa.
She ___ her wallet stolen on the metro.
哪句表示「找人修了电脑」？
questions.explanation: have sth done = 安排别人做。

questions.prompt: We're ___ our kitchen painted next week.（get 进行时）

nodes.title: 限定性关系从句
nodes.organizer: 用一句从句给名词「贴标签」：the man who lives next door。who 指人、which 指物、that 两者皆可、where 指地点。

explanation.text: who / which / that / where / whose 连接从句并充当句子成分；限定性从句不加逗号，是名词信息的一部分。

items: The woman who lives upstairs is a doctor.
This is the book (that) I told you about.
That's the café where we first met.
He's the guy whose dog barks all night.

explanation.text: 口诀：人用 who，物用 which，地点用 where，「谁的」用 whose；that 人物两用。

activity.prompt: 用 who 或 where 写一句描述你喜欢的人或地方。
activity.sampleAnswer: I miss the city where I grew up.

questions.prompt: The chef ___ made this soup is my uncle.
This is the hotel ___ we stayed last summer.
She's the writer ___ books sold millions.
That's the beach ___ we got married.

nodes.title: 非限定性关系从句
nodes.organizer: 逗号一加，从句变成「补充说明」：My mother, who is 70, swims every day。信息可有可无，去掉句子仍完整。

explanation.text: 非限定从句用逗号隔开，不用 that；which 可指代前面整句话（He was late, which annoyed everyone）。

items: My boss, who studied in Japan, speaks fluent Japanese.
The Eiffel Tower, which was built in 1889, is iron.
We visited Kyoto, where she was born.
He passed the exam, which surprised us all.

explanation.text: which 指代前面整句是 B2 的关键一步——「这件事，让大家很意外」。

activity.prompt: 介绍你的一位家人，用非限定从句补充一条信息。
activity.sampleAnswer: My father, who is a retired teacher, loves chess.

questions.prompt: My car, ___ I bought last year, keeps breaking down.
He was an hour late, ___ made everyone angry.
哪句的逗号从句是「可删的补充信息」？
options: The train that leaves at six is full.
Beijing, which is the capital, is huge.
People who smoke should go outside.
The book that I read was great.
questions.explanation: 逗号 + which = 补充说明。

questions.prompt: Anna, ___ speaks five languages, works with me.

nodes.title: 缩略关系从句（分词结构）
nodes.organizer: 把关系从句「瘦身」成分词短语：the man standing by the door = who is standing。C1 书面语的紧凑秘诀。

explanation.text: 主动 / 进行 → V-ing（the girl wearing red）；被动 → V3（the novel written in 1920）；完成 / 原因 → Having done（Having finished, she left）。

items: Anyone wishing to join should sign up today.
The proposals put forward yesterday were rejected.
Having lived in Italy for years, she speaks like a native.
The man standing at the gate is my landlord.

explanation.text: 判断被动还是主动：看被修饰名词与动词的关系——「被写的小说」用 written，「站着的人」用 standing。

activity.prompt: 把 a report which was written last week 改写成缩略形式。
activity.sampleAnswer: a report written last week

questions.prompt: The people ___ in the queue have been waiting for hours.
a poem ___ by Li Bai
___ the report, she went home.
questions.explanation: 先发生的动作 → Having done。

questions.prompt: The goods ___ (produce) in this factory are exported.

nodes.title: 第二条件句
nodes.organizer: 与现在事实相反的假设：If I had time, I would travel。从句退一步用过去式，主句用 would + 动词原形——「假设的语气」全靠这个「退一步」表达。

explanation.text: If + 过去式, would / could / might + 原形。正式用法 If I were you。与第一条件句的区别：真实可能 vs 想象假设。

items: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
If I were you, I would apologize.
She would help if she knew the answer.
We could go hiking if it weren't raining.

explanation.text: 比喻：第一条件句是「天气预报」（可能下雨），第二条件句是「白日梦」（要是能下雨就好了）。

activity.prompt: 写一句「如果我有一百万」的假设。
activity.sampleAnswer: If I had a million yuan, I would open a café by the sea.

questions.prompt: If I ___ you, I would take the job.
questions.explanation: 虚拟语气正式形式 were。

questions.prompt: If she ___ more time, she would learn the piano.
We ___ camping if the weather were better.
If I ___ (have) a garden, I would grow tomatoes.

nodes.title: 第三条件句
nodes.organizer: 对「过去的遗憾」做假设：If I had known, I would have come。从句 had done，主句 would have done——时间机器只对过去开放。

explanation.text: If + had + V3, would / could / might have + V3。谈论与过去事实相反、无法改变的假设及其结果。

items: If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the flight.
She would have passed if she had revised.
I wouldn't have believed it if I hadn't seen it myself.
If you had told me, I could have helped.

explanation.text: 三个 had 分家：从句 If I had known；主句 would have known。从句里别写成 would have known ✗。

activity.prompt: 写一件你后悔的小事，用第三条件句重写历史。
activity.sampleAnswer: If I had set an alarm, I would not have missed the interview.

questions.prompt: If you ___ me, I would have helped.
We ___ the train if we hadn't run.
哪句是第三条件句？
options: If it rains, we stay in.
If it rained, we would stay in.
If it had rained, we would have stayed in.
If it will rain, we will stay in.

questions.prompt: If she ___ (study) harder, she would have passed.

nodes.title: wish / if only
nodes.organizer: 「要是…就好了」的专用语法：wish + 过去式管现在，wish + had done 管过去。比 if 更纯粹的「愿望」。

explanation.text: wish + 过去式（现在的愿望：I wish I knew）；wish + had done（过去的遗憾：I wish I had known）；wish + would（对他人行为的抱怨：I wish you would listen）。

items: I wish I spoke French.
I wish I hadn't said that.
I wish it would stop raining.
If only we had more time!

explanation.text: wish 后的过去式不代表过去——它表示「与现在相反」。I wish I was rich = 我现在并不富。

activity.prompt: 写一条你的 wish（现在）+ 一条 regret（过去）。
activity.sampleAnswer: I wish I could sing; I wish I had started earlier.

questions.prompt: I wish I ___ how to dance.
questions.explanation: 与现在相反 → 过去式。

questions.prompt: I wish I ___ to her graduation last year.
It's raining again. I wish it ___ stop.
questions.explanation: wish + would 表对他人/外物的抱怨。

questions.prompt: I wish I ___ (not / eat) that much last night.
questions.explanation: 过去遗憾 → had not eaten。

nodes.title: 混合条件句
nodes.organizer: 时间可以错位：过去的因，现在的果。If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now。C1 的条件句不再锁定同一段时间。

explanation.text: 类型混搭：If + had done（过去）, would + 原形（现在）；If + 过去式（现在状况）, would have done（过去结果）。依据语义分别为「因」与「果」选时态。

items: If I had taken that job, I would be living in Tokyo now.
If she were more careful, she wouldn't have crashed the car last week.
We would be rich now if we had invested in 2010.
If he were taller, he would have made the team last year.

explanation.text: 判断口诀：先问「因在何时，果在何时」，再各选各的形态——不必成对出现。

activity.prompt: 写一句「过去的决定影响现在」的混合条件句。
activity.sampleAnswer: If I had learned to swim as a kid, I would be a diver today.

questions.prompt: If I ___ that contract, I would be rich now.
If he weren't so shy, he ___ her out last week.
questions.explanation: 现在的因 → 过去的果 would have asked。

questions.prompt: If I had caught the earlier train, I ___ here by now.
questions.explanation: 过去的因 → 现在的果 would be。

questions.prompt: If she had worn a helmet, she ___ (not / be) in hospital now.
questions.explanation: 过去因 → 现在果 would not be。

nodes.title: 正式虚拟与倒装
nodes.organizer: 书面语与正式场合的「高级语法」：Were she my superior… / Had it not been for… / It is essential that he be present。C2 的标志之一。

explanation.text: were 型倒装（If she were… → Were she…）；had 型倒装（If he had known → Had he known）；命令性虚拟：suggest / insist / demand / essential + that + 动词原形（that he be / that she submit）。

items: Had I known about the delay, I would have reordered my day.
Were the contract to lapse, we would renegotiate.
The board demanded that the report be revised.
It is imperative that every applicant submit the form by Friday.

explanation.text: 识别信号：建议 / 要求 / 必要（suggest, insist, essential）后面的 that 从句里动词「不变形」——he be, she submit。

activity.prompt: 把 If the system were to fail, we would lose data 改写为倒装形式。
activity.sampleAnswer: Were the system to fail, we would lose data.

questions.prompt: ___ it not been for your help, I would have failed.
questions.explanation: had 型倒装：Had it not been for…

questions.prompt: The committee insisted that the rule ___ abolished.
questions.explanation: 命令性虚拟：动词原形 be。

questions.prompt: ___ the worst happen, we have a backup plan.
The dean recommended that every student ___ (submit) the form online.

nodes.title: 家庭与人物词汇
nodes.organizer: 介绍家人和人物：家庭称谓、职业、外貌与性格。这是从「我」扩展到「我的生活」的核心词汇。

explanation.text: 家庭成员：father, mother, brother, sister。职业：doctor, nurse, engineer。描述：tall, friendly, kind。

items: I have a big family.
My father is a doctor.
She is tall and friendly.
This is my sister.

explanation.text: 家庭词汇是「相册标签」——给每个家人贴一个称呼和一个特点。

activity.prompt: 写两句介绍你的家人，再写一句他们的特点。
activity.sampleAnswer: I have one sister. She is a nurse. She is very kind.

questions.prompt: 「哥哥/弟弟」是？

My ___ (father/mother) is a doctor.（父亲）

nodes.title: 日常生活与作息词汇
nodes.organizer: 日常生活与作息词汇是描述一天的核心词库：起床、吃饭、上班、睡觉等固定搭配。

explanation.text: 核心搭配：get up, have breakfast, go to work, take a walk, go to bed。时间用 at + 钟点。

items: I get up at 7.
I have breakfast at 7:30.
I go to work by bus.
After dinner, I take a walk.
I go to bed at 11.

explanation.text: 作息词汇是「流水线工序」，每个时间点配一个动作。

activity.sampleAnswer: get up, have breakfast, go to bed

questions.prompt: I have ___ at 7:30.（吃早餐）

nodes.title: 爱好与休闲词汇
nodes.organizer: 爱好与休闲词汇让你能聊「你平时喜欢做什么」：运动、音乐、阅读等。

explanation.text: 搭配规律：play + 球类/乐器（play football, play the guitar）；go + -ing（go swimming, go shopping）；like / enjoy + doing。

items: I like playing football.
She enjoys painting.
He goes swimming every week.
My hobby is reading.

explanation.text: 记搭配：play 球类/乐器、go -ing、like / enjoy doing。

activity.prompt: 写一句你的爱好。
activity.sampleAnswer: I like playing basketball.

questions.prompt: 「打篮球」用哪个动词？

nodes.title: 工作与学习词汇
nodes.organizer: 工作与学习词汇涵盖职业、工作场景和学习表达：engineer, meeting, homework, exam 等。

explanation.text: 职业：engineer, doctor, manager。工作：meeting, project, office。学习：homework, exam, subject。

items: I'm an engineer.
I have a meeting at 10.
She does her homework after dinner.
English is my favorite subject.

explanation.text: 把「工作」和「学习」看作两个抽屉，各装一组高频词。

activity.prompt: 写一句关于你工作或学习的话。
activity.sampleAnswer: I have a meeting at 10.

questions.prompt: 「会议」是？

nodes.title: 城市与购物词汇
nodes.organizer: 问路、购物与城市场景的高频词汇和表达：银行、超市、直走、左转等。

explanation.text: 地点：bank, supermarket, station。方向：go straight, turn left/right。位置：next to, across from。购物：How much is it?

items: Excuse me, where is the bank?
Go straight and turn left at the corner.
The hotel is next to the park.
How much is this shirt? — It's 99 yuan.

explanation.text: 指路像「给导航 App 输入指令」——方向 + 参照物，一条指令一步。

activity.prompt: 写两句问路和两句指路的小对话。
activity.sampleAnswer: A: Excuse me, where is the hospital? B: Go straight and turn right. It's next to the school.

questions.explanation: Excuse me 用于礼貌引起注意。

「直走」怎么说？

nodes.title: 旅行与服务词汇
nodes.organizer: 旅行与服务词汇：订票、酒店、问路、服务请求等出行场景的表达。

explanation.text: 核心表达：ticket, hotel, airport, check in, book a room。服务请求：Can I have...? / I'd like to...

items: I need a ticket to Beijing.
We booked a room at the hotel.
Where is the check-in desk?
I'd like a window seat.

explanation.text: 旅行场景套话固定：订票、入住、询问，句型都差不多。

activity.sampleAnswer: I'd like a window seat.

nodes.title: 抽象话题词汇
nodes.organizer: 谈论社会、科技、环境，需要「看不见的名词」：development, impact, issue, policy。B2 的讨论从生活走向观点。

explanation.text: 高频抽象名词：development / impact / issue / policy / trend / benefit / risk / solution；常见搭配：have an impact on, raise an issue, pose a risk, offer a solution。

items: Social media has a huge impact on teenagers.
The government introduced a new policy to cut emissions.
Pollution is a serious issue in big cities.
Technology brings both benefits and risks.

explanation.text: 议论文骨架词：issue（问题）→ cause（原因）→ impact（影响）→ solution（对策）。

activity.prompt: 就「短视频对青少年的影响」写两句话，用上 impact 和 solution。
activity.sampleAnswer: Short videos have a big impact on teenagers. One solution is to limit screen time.

nodes.title: 基础形容词
nodes.organizer: 基础形容词描述性格、外貌和感受：tall, friendly, happy, tired 等，让表达更生动。

explanation.text: 外貌：tall, short, big, small。性格：friendly, kind, funny。感受：happy, tired, hungry, angry。

items: He is tall and funny.
She is very kind.
I am tired today.
The box is small.

explanation.text: 形容词像「贴标签」，给名词或人贴上特征。

activity.prompt: 用 3 个形容词描述你最好的朋友。
activity.sampleAnswer: He is tall, funny and kind.

questions.prompt: 「友好的」是？
「饿的」是？
「矮的」是？

nodes.title: 常用动词与搭配
nodes.organizer: 常用动词与固定搭配（go to work, have dinner, take a walk）是开口说话的骨架。

explanation.text: have + 三餐/名词（have breakfast, have a good time）；go + 方向（go to work, go home）；take + 名词（take a walk, take a photo）。

items: I have dinner at 7.
She goes home at 6.
We take a walk after dinner.
He takes photos every day.

explanation.text: 动词搭配是「固定组合拳」：have / go / take 各带一群搭档。

activity.prompt: 用 have / go / take 各写一个短语。
activity.sampleAnswer: have lunch, go to school, take a photo

「拍照」是？
I ___ (go / take) home at 6.（回家）
questions.explanation: go home = 回家（固定搭配）。

nodes.title: 常见前后缀
nodes.organizer: 英语构词的「乐高块」：-er / -tion / -ful / un-… 认识几十个词缀，等于多认识几百个词。

explanation.text: 后缀定词性：-er（teacher 指人）、-tion（information 名词）、-ful / -less（helpful / careless 形容词）、-ly（quickly 副词）；前缀改词义：un- / in- / dis-（否定）、re-（再次）、pre-（提前）。

items: teach → teacher, act → action, hope → hopeful, care → careless
happy → unhappy, do → redo
quick → quickly, luck → lucky
use → useful, useless, reuse

explanation.text: 读到生词先「拆积木」：un-comfort-able = 不 + 舒适 + 形容词尾 → 不舒服的。

activity.sampleAnswer: driver; unlucky

questions.prompt: Add the suffix for 'someone who writes': ___

nodes.title: 否定前缀与词形变化
nodes.organizer: 「不」有很多种写法：un- / in- / im- / il- / ir- / dis- / mis-。选错前缀是 B2 写作的高频扣分点。

explanation.text: un-（unfair, unusual）；in-（inactive），im- + p/b/m（impossible, impatient），il- + l（illegal），ir- + r（irregular）；dis-（disagree, dishonest）；mis-（误解：mislead, misunderstanding）。

items: unfair, unusual, impolite, illegal, irregular, disagree
incomplete, independent, impatient, illogical
misunderstand, mislead, misuse
dishonest, dislike, disconnect

explanation.text: 记住「磁铁伙伴」：im 陪 p（impossible）、il 陪 l（illegal）、ir 陪 r（irregular）——同类字母互相吸引。

activity.prompt: 给 polite / legal / regular 加上正确的否定前缀。
activity.sampleAnswer: impolite, illegal, irregular

nodes.title: 词性转换与名词化
nodes.organizer: 英语的「词性变形术」：动词名词化（a decision）、形容词名词化（ability）。名词化是学术与正式文体的引擎。

explanation.text: 动词 → 名词：decide → decision, fail → failure, refuse → refusal, analyse → analysis；形容词 → 名词：able → ability, poor → poverty；名词化让句子客观紧凑（the implementation of the policy）。

items: They decided to expand. → the decision to expand
The system failed. → the failure of the system
analyse → analysis, explain → explanation
poor → poverty, able → ability

explanation.text: 学术写作偏爱「名词化」：把动作冻成概念（We analysed the data → the analysis of the data）。

activity.sampleAnswer: the rapid improvement of the system

Data was looked at by them quickly.
questions.explanation: 名词化 + 被动 = 学术腔。

questions.prompt: His ___ (refuse) to comment surprised us.

nodes.title: 常见动词搭配
nodes.organizer: 英语不说 make a photo、do a decision——搭配是母语感的骨架：have a rest, take a photo, make a decision。

explanation.text: 高频「万能动词」搭配：have a rest / a bath / a talk；take a photo / a shower / an exam；make a decision / a mistake / progress；do homework / business / one's best；pay attention / a visit。

items: take a photo, have a shower, make progress
do your best, pay attention
make friends, have fun
take a break, do the dishes

explanation.text: 记「块」不记「词」：像背成语一样整块背搭配。

activity.prompt: 用 make / take / have / do 各写一个搭配句子。
activity.sampleAnswer: We made progress; take a break; have fun; do your best.

nodes.title: 核心短语动词
nodes.organizer: 动词 + 小品词 = 新动词：give up（放弃）、put off（推迟）、look forward to（期待）。短语动词是口语的心跳。

explanation.text: 可分与不可分：turn off the light / turn it off（代词必须放中间）；三类：及物可分（put off）、及物不可分（look after）、不及物（take off）。

items: give up smoking, put off the meeting
look after my sister, run into an old friend
The plane took off.
I'm looking forward to seeing you.

explanation.text: 代词是「试金石」：turn it off ✓，turn off it ✗——可分短语动词代词必居中。

activity.prompt: 用 look forward to 写一句你期待的事。
activity.sampleAnswer: I'm looking forward to the winter holiday.

哪句代词位置正确？
questions.explanation: 可分短语动词代词居中。

nodes.title: 习语与隐喻
nodes.organizer: C1 的语言有画面感：once in a blue moon（千载难逢）、a piece of cake（小菜一碟）。习语是文化的化石。

explanation.text: 高频习语：a piece of cake（轻而易举）、once in a blue moon（极罕见）、hit the nail on the head（一针见血）、under the weather（不舒服）、break the ice（打破僵局）。

items: Don't worry — the test was a piece of cake.
We go to the theatre once in a blue moon.
Your analysis hit the nail on the head.
A little game broke the ice at the meeting.

explanation.text: 习语不可逐字翻译，也不可改动成分——「a piece of cakes」✗。

activity.prompt: 用一个习语形容你最近的一件事。
activity.sampleAnswer: The interview was a piece of cake.

questions.prompt: "a piece of cake" 的意思是：

We meet once upon a time.

nodes.title: 音素与音标
nodes.organizer: 音素是英语最小的发音单位，音标是它的「拼音」。掌握元音/辅音音素是发音准确的基础。

explanation.text: 英语约 44 个音素：20 个元音（含双元音）+ 24 个辅音。元音如 /iː/ /ɪ/ /æ/ /ɑː/；辅音如 /p/ /b/ /t/ /d/。

items: /iː/ — see, meet
/ɪ/ — sit, big
/æ/ — cat, map
/θ/ — think, three

explanation.text: 音标像乐谱，音素是音符——先认识符号，再听音模仿。（音频练习将在后续版本接入）

activity.prompt: 写出 3 个你最容易读错的音标符号。

questions.prompt: 下面哪个是元音音素？
下面哪个是辅音音素？
英语约有多少个音素？
questions.explanation: 约 44 个：20 元音 + 24 辅音。

questions.prompt: cat 中的元音音素是 /___/

nodes.title: 尾音发音
nodes.organizer: 动词/名词的尾音 -s/-es/-ed 有发音规则，读错会影响理解。这是从拼写到发音的关键一环。

explanation.text: -s/-es：清辅音后读 /s/（books），浊辅音/元音后读 /z/（pens），s/x/ch/sh 后读 /ɪz/（watches）。-ed：清音后 /t/（watched），浊音后 /d/（played），t/d 后 /ɪd/（wanted）。

items: books /s/, pens /z/, watches /ɪz/
watched /t/, played /d/, wanted /ɪd/

explanation.text: 尾音规则像「红绿灯」——清辅音后读 /s/、浊辅音后读 /z/。

activity.prompt: 说出 books / pens / watched 的尾音分别是哪个音素。

questions.prompt: books 的 -s 读？
pens 的 -s 读？
watched 的 -ed 读？
wanted 的 -ed 读 /___/
questions.explanation: t 结尾的动词 -ed 读 /ɪd/。

nodes.title: 单词重音与句子重音
nodes.organizer: 重音是发音的「节拍器」：单词重音（如 PHO-to）和句子重音（强调关键实义词）决定听感。

explanation.text: 单词重音：双音节名词常重读第一音节（PHOto），双音节动词常重读第二音节（reLAX）。句子重音：实义词（名词/动词/形容词）重读，虚词（冠词/介词）弱读。

items: 'photo（名词·前重） / re'lax（动词·后重）
I 'want a 'cup of 'coffee.（实义词重读）

explanation.text: 重音放对，老外才听得懂——词重音是单词的「身份证」。

activity.prompt: 标注 photo 和 relax 的重音位置。
activity.sampleAnswer: PHO-to / re-LAX

questions.prompt: photo 的重音在哪个音节？
relax 的重音在？
句子中通常重读哪类词？

nodes.title: 语调与连读
nodes.organizer: 语调（升调问/降调陈）和连读（辅音+元音粘连）让英语说得更自然流畅。

explanation.text: 一般疑问句用升调（Are you ready? ↗），陈述句和 Wh- 问句用降调（What's your name? ↘）。连读：an apple → /ənæpl/。

items: Are you ready? ↗
What's your name? ↘
an apple → a-napple
get up → ge-tup

explanation.text: 语调是「情绪表情」，连读是「顺滑剂」。

activity.prompt: 标出 Are you ready? 的语调方向（升/降）。
activity.sampleAnswer: 升调（↗）

questions.prompt: 一般疑问句通常用？
陈述句通常用？
an apple 连读后听起来像？
get ___ 连读成 ge-tup（一个词）

nodes.title: 弱读与连读
nodes.organizer: 母语者说得快，是因为虚词在「偷懒」：can 读 /kən/，an apple 连成 /əˈnæpl/。听懂快语速的钥匙。

explanation.text: 弱读：a / the / to / of / and / can 在句中读弱式（/ə/, /tə/, /əv/…）；连读：辅音 + 元音相连（an apple → a-napple），/t/ + /j/ → /tʃ/（meet you → mee-chew）。

items: a cup of tea → /ə kʌp əv tiː/
fish and chips → fish-an-chips
meet you → /miːtʃu/
not at all → no-ta-tall

explanation.text: 听不懂快语速，往往不是词汇量问题，而是你的耳朵在等「完整强读」。

activity.prompt: 朗读 a lot of apples and an orange，注意连读。
activity.sampleAnswer: /ə lɒt əv æplz ənd ən ɒrɪndʒ/

questions.prompt: 连读后 'an apple' 的听觉效果最接近：
'meet you' 口语中常读成：
句中的 'to' 通常读成：

questions.explanation: 虚词 of 常弱读为 /əv/。

nodes.title: 击穿与同化
nodes.organizer: 语速再快一层：/t/ /d/ 会「消失」（next day → nex-day），/n/ 在唇音前会「变身」（in Paris → im-Paris）。这就是你听不清的元凶。

explanation.text: 击穿 elision：next day → /neks deɪ/、must be → /mʌs bi/（/t/ 消失）；同化 assimilation：ten boys → tem boys（/n/→/m/）、would you → /wʊdʒu/（/d/+/j/→/dʒ/）。

items: next day → /neks deɪ/
used to → /juːs tə/
would you → wou-joo
in Paris → im-Paris

explanation.text: 同化不是「说错」，是发音为省力自动「顺滑」的结果——你的嘴也会这么做。

activity.prompt: 朗读 good morning 与 did you eat，体会 /d/ 的轻化与 /d/+/j/→/dʒ/。
activity.sampleAnswer: good morning → goo(d) morning; did you → di-ju

questions.prompt: 'used to' 最自然的读法是：
'would you' 快速口语常读成：
'good morning' 中 /d/ 常发生什么？
同化：'ten boys' 快读时 ten 的尾音 /n/ 常变成 ___（写一个音标字母）。
questions.explanation: /n/ 在双唇音 /b/ 前同化为 /m/。

nodes.title: 意羣切分与节奏
nodes.organizer: 母语者不按「词」说话，按「意羣」说话：The problem / is that we ran out of time。切分对了，重音与语调自然就对了。

explanation.text: 意羣 chunking：一个意羣一口气说完，羣末带边界调（微降或微升）；英语是重音计时（stress-timed）——重读词之间时间等距，虚词被压缩。

items: What we need / is a clearer plan.
Although it was raining / we decided to go.
The point I am making / is quite simple.
If you ask me / it is a mistake.

explanation.text: 练习法：在长句里画「/」，每个斜杠一口气——你的英语立刻有母语者的节奏骨架。

activity.prompt: 给长句画意羣并朗读：Although the deadline is tight, we can still deliver quality work.
activity.sampleAnswer: Although the deadline is tight, / we can still deliver quality work.

questions.prompt: 英语的节奏类型属于：

options: What we need / is a plan.
What / we need is / a plan.

What we need is / a / plan.
