nodes.title: 问候与个人信息
nodes.organizer: 问候与个人信息是英语社交的起点：打招呼、寒暄、介绍自己（名字、来自哪里、职业）。

explanation.text: 问候：Hello / Good morning / How are you? 介绍：My name is... / I'm from... / I'm 25 (years old). / I'm a student.

items: A: Hi! How are you? B: I'm fine, thanks.
My name is Wang Fang. I'm from Chengdu.
What do you do? — I'm an engineer.
Nice to meet you.

explanation.text: 问候语是社交的「开机握手协议」，自我介绍像一张「个人名片」。

activity.prompt: 写一段 4 句的自我介绍 + 问候。
activity.sampleAnswer: Hi! My name is Chen Wei. I'm from Hangzhou. I'm a designer. Nice to meet you!

questions.prompt: 询问对方来自哪里，应该说？
questions.explanation: Where are you from? 问国籍/家乡。

questions.prompt: I'm ___ engineer.（注意冠词）
questions.explanation: engineer 以元音音素开头，用 an。

questions.prompt: What do you do? 是在问什么？
I'm ___ China.（填介词）

nodes.title: 描述日常习惯与作息
nodes.organizer: 描述一天的作息是一般现在时最经典的应用场景——这个功能节点把语法地图里的时态真正「用起来」。

explanation.text: 按时间顺序描述：I get up at 7. I have breakfast at 7:30. I go to work at 9. In the evening, I watch TV. I go to bed at 11.

items: I get up at 7 o'clock.
I have breakfast and then go to work.
After dinner, I take a walk.
I usually go to bed before midnight.

explanation.text: 一天的作息是一条「流水线」，每个时间点是一道工序，一般现在时就是传动带。

activity.prompt: 写 3 句你的日常作息，每句带上时间。
activity.sampleAnswer: I get up at 7. I go to work at 9. I read before bed.

questions.prompt: I get ___ at 7 every morning.（起床）
I ___ breakfast at 7:30.（吃早餐）
描述日常作息，用哪种时态最合适？
questions.explanation: 日常习惯用一般现在时。

questions.prompt: I go to ___ at 11 p.m.（上床睡觉）
questions.explanation: go to bed = 上床睡觉。

nodes.title: 描述人物与感受
nodes.organizer: 描述人物的外貌、性格和感受，把「他是个怎样的人」说得更具体。

explanation.text: 外貌：He is tall with short hair. 性格：She is friendly and kind. 感受：He looks tired today.

items: He is tall with short hair.
She is friendly and kind.
He looks tired today.
My brother is funny and outgoing.

explanation.text: 描述人物 = 外貌 + 性格 + 当下感受，三件套。

activity.prompt: 用 3 句话描述一个人。
activity.sampleAnswer: My sister is tall with long hair. She is friendly. She looks happy today.

questions.prompt: 描述外貌的正确说法是？
options: He is tall with short hair.
questions.explanation: be + 外貌，with 补充特征。

questions.prompt: 「外向的」是？
He looks ___ today.（累的）
She is ___ (friendly / kind) and helpful.（友好的）

nodes.title: 描述地点与城市
nodes.organizer: 描述地点与城市：位置、大小、特色和你的感受，让别人「看见」你描述的地方。

explanation.text: 位置：It's in the south of China. 特征：It's small but beautiful. 便利：There are many shops and restaurants.

items: My town is small but beautiful.
It's in the south of China.
There are many parks in the city.
It's quiet in the morning.

explanation.text: 描述地点 = 位置 + 特征 + 有什么 + 感受。

activity.prompt: 写 3 句描述你的城市。
activity.sampleAnswer: My city is in the south of China. It's big and busy. There are many restaurants.

questions.prompt: 描述城市特征的正确说法是？
「安静的」是？
There ___ many parks in the city.
It's in the ___ (south / north) of China.（南方）

nodes.title: 描述过去经历
nodes.organizer: 用一般过去时讲述旅行、学习等经历，按时间顺序把故事说清楚。

explanation.text: 常用句型：Last year I went to... / I visited... / It was... 时间标记：last year, two years ago, in 2023。

items: Last year I went to Shanghai.
I visited the museum with my friends.
It was a wonderful trip.
Two years ago I learned to swim.

explanation.text: 讲经历 = 时间 + 事件 + 感受，过去时全程护航。

activity.prompt: 用过去时写 3 句你的旅行经历。
activity.sampleAnswer: Last year I went to Beijing. I visited the Great Wall. It was amazing!

questions.prompt: 「去年」是？
questions.explanation: last year = 去年（无需加 ago）。

questions.prompt: I ___ the museum last week.
It ___ a wonderful trip.
Two years ago I ___ (go) to Beijing.（过去式）

nodes.title: 请求与建议
nodes.organizer: 礼貌地提出请求（Can / Could you...?）和建议（Let's... / You should...）是日常交流的润滑剂。

explanation.text: 请求：Can you help me? / Could you open the window? 建议：Let's go. / You should rest. / Why not try it?

items: Can you help me, please?
Could you open the window?
Let's have lunch together.
You should drink more water.

explanation.text: 请求用 Can / Could + you；建议用 Let's / You should。

activity.prompt: 写一句请求和一句建议。
activity.sampleAnswer: Could you pass me the salt? / You should take a break.

questions.prompt: 更礼貌的请求是？
questions.explanation: Could you... 比 Can you... 更礼貌。

questions.prompt: 「我们走吧」是？
建议休息：You ___ rest.
___ you pass me the salt?（更礼貌的请求，Could / Can）

nodes.title: 表达观点与同意
nodes.organizer: 表达观点（I think...）和同意/不同意（I agree / I don't agree）让你参与讨论而不是旁观。

explanation.text: 观点：I think this movie is great. / In my opinion... 同意：I agree with you. / That's right. 不同意：I don't agree. / I'm afraid not.

items: I think English is useful.
In my opinion, this is a good idea.
I agree with you.
I'm afraid I don't agree.

explanation.text: 讨论三步：亮观点 → 说理由 → 回应对方。

activity.prompt: 写一句你的观点和一句同意/不同意。
activity.sampleAnswer: I think it's a good idea. / I agree with you.

questions.prompt: 表达观点用？
questions.explanation: I think... 表达我的看法。

questions.prompt: 「我同意」是？
委婉不同意：I'm ___ I don't agree.
I ___ (agree / disagree) with you.（同意）

nodes.title: 讲述故事与个人经历
nodes.organizer: 从「流水账」到「有画面的故事」：用过去进行时布景、一般过去时推进、when / while 转折。

explanation.text: 叙事三板斧：was doing 布景（It was raining）→ did 推进（my phone rang）→ when / while / suddenly 连接；结尾加感受（Luckily / In the end）。

items: I was walking home when I saw an old friend.
While we were cooking, the power went out.
Suddenly, the dog started barking.
In the end, everything turned out fine.

explanation.text: was doing 是「舞台」，did 是「剧情」——先搭台，再演戏。

activity.prompt: 用「布景 + 事件」写一段你难忘的小插曲。
activity.sampleAnswer: I was riding my bike when a cat jumped out; luckily, I stopped in time.

questions.prompt: I ___ home when it started to rain.
While she ___ dinner, the phone rang.
哪句是「布景」句？
options: It was a cold night and the streets were empty.

questions.prompt: The lights went out while we ___ (watch) TV.

nodes.title: 投诉与致歉
nodes.organizer: 有礼有节地不满：说明问题 → 提出诉求 → 期待答复；以及得体道歉：道歉 + 解释 + 补救。

explanation.text: 投诉模板：I am afraid there is a problem with… / This is not what I ordered. / I would like a refund, please. 道歉模板：I am really sorry… / It will not happen again. / Let me fix it right away.

items: Excuse me, I think there is a mistake in the bill.
I'm afraid my room hasn't been cleaned.
I'm so sorry for the delay — I'll fix it right away.
Would it be possible to get a replacement?

explanation.text: 投诉的黄金结构：事实（不带情绪）→ 影响 → 你想要的解决方案。

activity.prompt: 写一封两句话的投诉（问题 + 诉求）。
activity.sampleAnswer: I'm afraid the shirt I ordered has a hole in it. Could I get a refund?

questions.prompt: 最礼貌的开启投诉方式是：
options: I'm afraid there's a problem with my order.
questions.explanation: I am afraid 缓和语气。

questions.prompt: 道歉后提出补救："___ I send you a new one?"
餐厅上错菜，哪句得体？
options: Excuse me — this isn't what I ordered.

questions.prompt: I'm really sorry ___ the delay.

nodes.title: 猜测与推断
nodes.organizer: 从线索推出结论：She must be… / He can't have… / It looks as if…。B2 讨论与侦探思维的通用引擎。

explanation.text: 现在推测 must / might / can't be；过去推测 must / can't have done；视觉线索 It looks / seems (as if / as though)…

items: The lights are off, so they must have gone out.
She looks exhausted — she might have been working all night.
It seems as if the meeting has been cancelled.
That can't be the last bus — it's only nine!

explanation.text: 推断三档：must（九成把握）、might / could（五成）、can't（零可能）——说话人用情态动词亮出把握。

activity.prompt: 同事今天没来开会，用 must / might / can't 写两句推断。
activity.sampleAnswer: She must be ill; she might have missed the train.

questions.prompt: The shop's closed at noon — they ___ be having lunch.
His car isn't here, so he ___ have left already.
questions.explanation: 对过去的推断 must have done。

questions.prompt: She looks upset. It ___ as if something happened.
The ground is wet — it ___ have rained last night.

nodes.title: 协商与说服
nodes.organizer: 说服的组合拳：提议（How about…）+ 让步（I see your point, but…）+ 互惠（If you…, we will…）。

explanation.text: 提议 How about / What if / Why don't we；让步 That's true, but… / I see what you mean, however…；条件交换 If you could…, we would…

items: How about splitting the cost?
I see your point, but the deadline is fixed.
What if we tried the other supplier?
If you can deliver by Friday, we will sign today.

explanation.text: 说服公式：先接住对方（认同部分）→ 再抛出你的方案 → 用利益收尾。

activity.prompt: 说服朋友周末一起搬家（用 How about + 让步）。
activity.sampleAnswer: How about Saturday morning? I know you're busy, but we'll be done by noon.

questions.prompt: 最自然的提议开场：
options: How about we try the other option?

questions.prompt: 先让步再反驳："I see your point, ___ the budget is tight."
条件式说服："___ you deliver early, we will place a bigger order."
How ___ we ask the supplier for a discount?

nodes.title: 缓和与模糊限制语
nodes.organizer: C1 的成熟 = 不把话说死：This may suggest… / It could be argued that… / sort of。学术与职场的「安全气囊」。

explanation.text: 模糊限制语 hedging：may / might / could、tend to、it appears that、arguably、to some extent；缓和语气 softening：I am afraid、perhaps、a bit、kind of。

items: The results may suggest a link between the two.
It could be argued that the policy was premature.
I'm afraid this doesn't quite work for us.
The data seems to point towards a trend.

explanation.text: 学术语气的黄金法则：结论越强，证据要越硬——证据不够时，用 hedging 降一档。

activity.prompt: 把 The policy failed 客气化，改写成 hedging 版本。
activity.sampleAnswer: The policy may not have achieved its intended goals.

questions.prompt: 最学术化的表达是：
options: The data proves we are right.
The data may suggest a correlation.

questions.prompt: 委婉表达反对：
options: I'm afraid I see it differently.

questions.prompt: 'tend to' 在 This age group tends to read less 中表达：
It ___ appear that the trial was successful.（填缓和助动词）

nodes.title: 外交式措辞与委婉语
nodes.organizer: C2 的语言艺术：把裁员说成 restructuring，把反对说成 concerns。委婉语与外交措辞的高级语域。

explanation.text: 委婉语 euphemism：let go / downsize（裁员）、pass away（去世）、pre-owned（二手）；外交措辞：We have some concerns（而非 We disagree）、with respect…、to put it delicately…

items: The company is letting go of 200 staff.（= downsize）
Her grandfather passed away last night.
With respect, I think we may be overlooking the risks.
To put it delicately, the proposal needs rework.

explanation.text: 委婉的度：太直白伤人，太委婉失真——C2 的功力在于「既准确又体面」。

activity.prompt: 把「这份报告有很多错误」改写成外交式反馈。
activity.sampleAnswer: I think the report could benefit from another round of editing.

questions.prompt: 'let go' 在职场语境中委婉表示：
最外交式的反对：
options: We have some concerns about the feasibility.

questions.prompt: 'pass away' 是 ___ 的委婉语：
With ___, I believe the timeline is unrealistic.

nodes.title: 连接词（语篇衔接）
nodes.organizer: 在语篇中，连接词把句子串成段落：and 并列、but 转折、because 因果。语法模块已讲过，这里练习用在段落里。

explanation.text: 段内衔接：I like tea, but my brother likes coffee. I stayed home because it rained. She sings well and dances well.

items: I like tea, but my brother likes coffee.
I stayed home because it was raining.
She sings and dances well.

explanation.text: 连接词是段落里的「胶水」，把孤立句子粘成整体。

activity.prompt: 用连接词把 3 个短句连成一段。
activity.sampleAnswer: I get up at 7 and have breakfast. I go to work by bus, but my friend walks. I like my job because it's interesting.

questions.prompt: 表达转折用哪个？
I was late ___ I missed the bus.（原因）
并列连接用哪个？
He is smart, ___ he is lazy.（转折，but）

nodes.title: 顺序标记
nodes.organizer: 顺序标记（first, then, after that, finally）让叙述有条理，讲故事、写步骤、说流程必备。

explanation.text: 顺序：First → Then → After that → Finally。例：First, I get up. Then I have breakfast. After that, I go to work. Finally, I go to bed.

items: First, wash the vegetables.
Then, cut them into pieces.
After that, cook for five minutes.
Finally, enjoy your meal.

explanation.text: 顺序标记是「路标」，让听众跟着你的思路走。

activity.prompt: 用 first / then / finally 写一个 3 步小流程。
activity.sampleAnswer: First, I wake up. Then, I brush my teeth. Finally, I have breakfast.

questions.prompt: 「然后」是？
「最后」是？
叙述第一步用哪个？
___, wash your hands.（首先，First）

nodes.title: 互动管理
nodes.organizer: 互动标记用于管理对话：没听清用 Pardon?，请求插话用 Excuse me?，确认理解用 Got it? / Right?

explanation.text: 没听清：Pardon? / Sorry, could you repeat that? 插话：Excuse me, ... 确认：Do you understand? / Right?

items: Pardon? Could you say that again?
Excuse me, may I ask a question?
You know what I mean, right?

explanation.text: 互动标记是「对话方向盘」——听不懂就及时打转向灯。

activity.prompt: 写一句没听清时请求重复的话。
activity.sampleAnswer: Pardon? Could you repeat that?

questions.prompt: 没听清时用？
请求重复：Could you ___ that?
确认对方理解：Do you ___?
questions.explanation: Do you understand? = 你明白吗？

questions.prompt: Excuse me, may I ask a ___?（问题）
questions.explanation: ask a question = 问一个问题。

nodes.title: 指代与替代
nodes.organizer: 让文章不重复的魔法：it / they / this / one、do too。名词不重复，句子才流畅。

explanation.text: 指代 it / they / them / this / that；替代 one / ones（代名词）、do / does / did（代动词）；this / that 可指代前面整句。

items: I bought a new bike. It cost 800 yuan.
These cups are dirty — bring the clean ones.
She works late and he does too.
He said the plan would fail. This worried us.

explanation.text: 指代要「就近清楚」：两个名词同时在场时，it / this 指谁要说清。

activity.prompt: 用 it / one / does too 改写三句，避免重复。
activity.sampleAnswer: I lost my key. I need to find it. This cup is broken — get a new one.

questions.prompt: I like this jacket, but I can't afford ___.
Your phone is new — mine is an old ___.
He plays chess well, and his son ___ too.
These shoes hurt. I will take ___ off.

nodes.title: 让步与对比衔接
nodes.organizer: 承认对方、坚持自己：although / despite / however / nevertheless。论证文与议论文的转折骨架。

explanation.text: although / though + 从句；despite / in spite of + 名词或 V-ing；however / nevertheless / nonetheless + 句；even though（更强）。

items: Although it was late, we kept working.
Despite the rain, the match went ahead.
The cost is high; however, the benefits outweigh it.
In spite of losing, they celebrated.

explanation.text: despite 后面不能跟完整句（✗ despite it was late）——名词化是它的工作。

activity.prompt: 用 although 和 despite 各写一句「坚持」。
activity.sampleAnswer: Although it was freezing, we hiked on. Despite the difficulty, she finished.

questions.prompt: ___ the traffic, we arrived on time.
___ it was expensive, they bought it.
The plan is risky; ___, it's worth trying.
___ spite of the noise, she kept reading.

nodes.title: 段落结构与语篇模式
nodes.organizer: 一段一件事：主题句（Topic）→ 展开（Explain / Example）→ 收束（Link）。B2 作文的段落骨架。

explanation.text: 段落 = 主题句 + 支撑句 + 收束 / 链接句；常见语篇模式：因果（cause-effect）、问题-对策（problem-solution）、对比（compare-contrast）。

items: Remote work has clear benefits. First, it saves commuting time. Second, it widens the talent pool. Overall, flexibility wins.
Many cities face traffic problems. One cause is underused public transport. A possible solution is cheaper fares.
Online learning is convenient, but it demands discipline.
To sum up, the advantages outweigh the drawbacks.

explanation.text: 检查段落：能一眼找到「主题句」吗？找不到，读者就迷路。

activity.prompt: 用「主题句 + 两点展开 + 收束」写一个四句段落（谈网课）。
activity.sampleAnswer: Online courses have changed learning. They save time and cost less. However, they need self-discipline. On balance, they are worth it.

questions.prompt: 段落的「主题句」通常出现在：
'problem-solution' 语篇的结构顺序是：
options: 问题 → 原因 → 对策
对策 → 问题 → 原因
原因 → 问题 → 问候
问题 → 问候 → 对策

questions.prompt: 下列哪句适合作主题句？
options: For example, my cousin studies online.
Online learning has both advantages and drawbacks.

questions.prompt: ___, we saved money by working remotely.（填「总体来说」的衔接词）

nodes.title: 词汇衔接与主位推进
nodes.organizer: 高手不靠 however 衔接，靠「词汇网」：同义复现（problem → issue → challenge）与上下义（animal → dog）。C1 的隐形粘合剂。

explanation.text: 词汇衔接：同义 / 近义复现、上下义（superordinate）、搭配链（hospital → doctor → treatment）；主位推进：每句开头（主位）如何承接上一句的述位。

items: The company faced a crisis. The problem was cash flow. Managers tackled the issue by cutting costs.
She adopted a dog. The animal changed her life.
Rising prices hit households. Families responded by buying less.
The trial failed. This outcome surprised the researchers.

explanation.text: 好文章读起来「词汇成网」：同一个概念换个衣服反复登场，而不是一直用 it。

activity.prompt: 用同义词链改写：The test was hard. The exam made students nervous.
activity.sampleAnswer: The test was demanding. Such exams often make students anxious.

questions.prompt: crisis → problem → issue 属于哪种衔接？
'She adopted a dog. The animal changed her life.' 中 the animal 是：
hospital → doctor → treatment 形成：
Rising costs hurt households. Many ___ responded by cutting spending.（填同义替换词）

nodes.title: 修辞与文体效果
nodes.organizer: C2 的说服与美感：排比（anaphora）、反问（rhetorical question）、暗喻（metaphor）。让语言从「正确」走向「有力」。

explanation.text: 排比与首语重复：We shall…, we shall…；设问反问：How can we ignore this?；暗喻：time is a thief；对照：not because it is easy, but because it is hard。

items: We came, we saw, we changed the rules.
How can we call ourselves green while burning coal?
Data is the new oil.
It's not about winning; it's about learning.

explanation.text: 修辞是「放大器」：逻辑对的内容，修辞让它被记住；逻辑错的内容，修辞让错误更响亮。

activity.prompt: 用一个排比或暗喻写一句关于学习的口号。
activity.sampleAnswer: Learning is a ladder — each question is one more rung.

questions.prompt: 'Data is the new oil.' 是：
'How can we ignore this?' 的修辞功能是：
'We shall work, we shall build, we shall grow.' 使用了：
A comparison using 'like / as' is called a ___（英文词）.

nodes.title: 听懂基本信息
nodes.organizer: 听懂数字、时间、价格等基本信息是听力入门的基本功。

explanation.text: 掌握数字、时间、价格的听辨：What time is it? It's half past nine. / How much is it? It's 99 yuan.

items: What time is it? — It's half past nine.
What's the date today? — It's August 21st.
How much is this shirt? — It's 99 yuan.

explanation.text: 时间/价格问答是「数字交换机」——句型固定，只需替换数字。

activity.prompt: 写出今天的日期和你此刻的时间，一问一答。
activity.sampleAnswer: What's the date today? — It's August 21st. / What time is it? — It's 3 o'clock.

questions.prompt: 9:30 用英语说是？
questions.explanation: 「几点半」用 half past + 小时。

questions.prompt: 问价格应该说？
It's ___ May 1st.（具体日期用哪个介词）
What ___ is it? — It's 8 o'clock.（问时间的疑问词）
questions.explanation: What time is it? 问时间。

nodes.title: 听懂短对话和公告
nodes.organizer: 听力进阶：从听懂单词到听懂短对话和公告的主旨与关键细节。

explanation.text: 策略：先抓关键词（时间/地点/数字），再判断说话人的意图（问路？订餐？通知？）。

items: Attention please, the train will arrive at 9:15.（公告）
A: Where shall we meet?  B: At the library.（对话）

explanation.text: 听对话抓「谁在何时何地做什么」，听公告抓时间和事项。

activity.prompt: 写出听懂一段英文广播需要抓住的 3 个要素。
activity.sampleAnswer: 时间、地点、要做什么

questions.prompt: 听公告时最该抓？
questions.explanation: 公告核心是时间和事项。

questions.prompt: 听对话时先判断？
没听清时最好的策略是？
听广播先抓 ___（时间 / 数字）

nodes.title: 听懂较长日常对话与叙述
nodes.organizer: 从短对话到「有情节的长对话」：抓住人物、时间线与转折点。B1 听力的关键词是「跟住线」。

explanation.text: 听力策略：先读题预测话题；抓信号词（but, actually, in the end）定位转折；记时间顺序（first, then, after that）。

items: Well, at first the flight was delayed, but in the end we made the connection.
I used to hate mornings, but since I started jogging…
The course was supposed to start in May, but it moved to June.
She said she'd call, and sure enough, she did.

explanation.text: 听长材料别逐词追——丢了就放，紧跟下一个信号词，线不能断。

activity.prompt: 听一段朋友叙述并复述三件关键事（时间线）。
activity.sampleAnswer: First the bus broke down; then we walked; in the end we were an hour late.

questions.prompt: 听到 'at first… but in the end…' 应预期：
B1 长对话听力最重要的策略是：
'The flight was supposed to leave at six.' 中 supposed to 提示：
听叙事时，先抓 first / ___ / in the end 这类顺序词。

nodes.title: 听出观点、态度与言外之意
nodes.organizer: B2 的耳朵要听「话里有话」：语调降了是敷衍，well… 是迟疑。说话人的态度藏在字缝里。

explanation.text: 推断态度：语气词（well, actually, to be honest）、语调（升调的不确定）、反讽（Great. Just great.）；区分事实与观点（I think / apparently / reportedly）。

items: "Nice weather, isn't it?"（看着大雨说）— 反讽
"Well, it's… an interesting choice." — 委婉的怀疑
"Apparently the meeting's off." — 听说类标记
"To be honest, I'd rather stay in."

explanation.text: 听到 Great. Just great. 先看语境——情绪与字面常常相反。

activity.prompt: 听一段对话，写下说话人对某安排的真实态度（支持 / 怀疑 / 反对）+ 一句依据。
activity.sampleAnswer: He's doubtful — he said 'well, if you think so' slowly.

questions.prompt: 'Well, it's an interesting choice…' 的弦外之音多半是：
'Apparently' 提示后面的信息是：
区分事实与观点的关键信号是：
options: I think / in my view 等观点标记

questions.prompt: 听到降调的 'Great.' 配合下雨画面，应推断为 ___（填中文两字：讽刺）。

nodes.title: 听懂讲座与隐含意义
nodes.organizer: C1 听力是「边听边建模」：讲座的信号语（Today I will outline… / The key point here…）、让步与修正（That said… / Or rather…）。

explanation.text: 讲座结构信号：introduce / outline / move on / summarize；修正信号：actually, or rather, that said；言外之意：intentionally vague（to some extent）。

items: Today I want to outline three competing models.
That said, the evidence is far from conclusive.
Or rather — let me reframe that.
The second point, which is often overlooked, is funding.

explanation.text: 听讲座先抓「路线图句」（Today I will cover X, Y and Z），再往三个抽屉里放笔记。

activity.prompt: 听一段 mini-lecture，用三行笔记记下 outline 的三点。
activity.sampleAnswer: 1) causes 2) current policies 3) open questions

questions.prompt: 'That said,' 在讲座中表示：
'Today I will outline three models' 的功能是：
'the evidence is far from conclusive' 意思是：
'Or rather — let me ___ that.'（重新表述）

nodes.title: 自我介绍和问答
nodes.organizer: 开口说的第一关：自我介绍 + 基础问答。把「我是谁、来自哪、做什么」说顺。

explanation.text: 结构：Hi, I'm... I'm from... I'm a... Nice to meet you. 互动问答：What's your name? Where are you from? How old are you?

items: Hi, I'm Tom. I'm from Beijing. Nice to meet you!
A: Where are you from?  B: I'm from Shanghai.

explanation.text: 自我介绍是「3 行名片」，问答是「接球练习」——对方抛一句，你接一句。

activity.prompt: 模拟一段 4 轮的自我介绍问答。
activity.sampleAnswer: A: Hi! What's your name?  B: I'm Li Ming.  A: Where are you from?  B: I'm from Shanghai.

questions.prompt: 开场打招呼说？
questions.explanation: Hi, I'm + 名字 是标准开场。

questions.prompt: 问名字：What's your ___?
问来自哪里：Where are you ___?
I'm ___ (from / of) Shanghai.（来自）

nodes.title: 描述日常与过去经历
nodes.organizer: 口语进阶：用一般现在时讲日常、用过去时讲经历，组织成 3-5 句的小独白。

explanation.text: 日常：Every day I get up at 7 and go to work. 经历：Last weekend I visited my grandparents.

items: Every day I get up at 7 and go to work.
Last weekend I visited my grandparents.
On Sundays I usually play football.

explanation.text: 小独白 = 1 句总起 + 2-3 句细节 + 1 句收尾。

activity.prompt: 写一段 3 句的口语独白（日常或经历）。
activity.sampleAnswer: Every day I get up at 7. I go to work by bus. On Sundays I usually play football.

questions.prompt: 讲日常用哪种时态？
questions.explanation: 日常习惯用一般现在时。

questions.prompt: 讲过去经历用？
On Sundays I usually ___ football.
Last weekend I ___ (visit) my grandparents.（过去式）

nodes.title: 表达与交换观点
nodes.organizer: 从描述生活到讨论看法：I think… because… / What about you? B1 口语的核心是「一来一回」。

explanation.text: 观点表达：I think / reckon… because…；追问他人 What do you think? / How about you?；软性不同意 Really? I would say…

items: I think it's better to live in a city, because everything is close.
— I prefer tea. — Really? I'd say coffee wins.
What's your take on working from home?
That's a fair point, but…

explanation.text: 对话像传球：说完观点记得回传问题（What about you?），别让球落地。

activity.prompt: 就「城市还是乡村生活更好」与同伴各给观点 + 理由 + 回问。
activity.sampleAnswer: I'd choose the city because of convenience. What about you?

questions.prompt: 给观点附上理由的句型是：
把对话继续下去的最佳问题：
软性表达不同意：
— I love winter. — ___ about you?

nodes.title: 小组讨论与辩论
nodes.organizer: B2 的讨论不是各说各话：承接（Building on that…）、打断得体（Sorry to jump in…）、总结归纳（So we agree that…）。

explanation.text: 承接 That is a good point — building on that…；礼貌打断 Sorry to interrupt, but…；归纳 So, to sum up our views…；让步重申 While I accept X, I still believe Y。

items: Building on what Maria said, we should also consider cost.
Sorry to jump in — can we clarify the data first?
While I accept the risks, the upside is bigger.
So, are we agreed that we pilot it in May?

explanation.text: 讨论力 = 观点 × 承接 × 时机：三个都要练。

activity.prompt: 用 Building on that… 承接同伴观点并补充一条。
activity.sampleAnswer: Building on that, I'd add that the timeline is too tight.

questions.prompt: 礼貌打断的短语是：
'Building on that…' 的功能是：
讨论收束句：
___ I accept the risks, I still believe we should try.

nodes.title: 流利度与精准表达
nodes.organizer: C1 口语的两翼：流利（绕过卡壳：self-correction、paraphrase）与精准（用最贴切的词，而不只是对的词）。

explanation.text: 补救策略：What is the word… it is like a… / or rather… / let me put it another way；精准升级：big → substantial，get → obtain / secure（语境适配）。

items: It's kind of a… workshop, or rather a hands-on seminar.
Let me put it another way — we're over budget.
The gains were modest but substantial enough to matter.
To put it precisely, we need 12 more weeks.

explanation.text: 母语者也卡壳——区别是他们把卡壳说得「很顺」：buy time 的过渡语要练熟。

activity.prompt: 用 paraphrase 解释一个你一时想不起来的词。
activity.sampleAnswer: It's the thing you use to… you know, slice bread — a knife.

questions.prompt: 一时想不起词时最 C1 的做法：
'Let me put it another way' 的功能：
正式汇报中 big profit 更好的替换是：
Or ___ — the deadline is June, not July.（纠正口误的短语）

nodes.title: 读懂简单文本主旨
nodes.organizer: 阅读入门：看懂简单广告、表格和短文的主旨，抓「谁、什么、多少、哪里」。

explanation.text: 策略：先看标题和图片，再扫读关键词，最后判断大意（是广告？通知？介绍？）。

items: Sale! Shoes ¥99.（广告主旨：打折卖鞋）
The library is open from 9 to 6.（通知主旨：开馆时间）

explanation.text: 主旨 = 一句话回答「这段话想告诉我什么」。

activity.prompt: 写一句「一条招聘广告的主旨」。
activity.sampleAnswer: The store needs a new worker.

questions.prompt: 阅读第一步是？
广告通常想让你？
通知类文本的主旨常是？
主旨就是一句话回答「这段在讲___」

nodes.title: 读懂短邮件和故事
nodes.organizer: 阅读进阶：读懂短邮件和简单故事的细节——事件顺序、人物关系和因果关系。

explanation.text: 邮件：抓主题、发件人意图、需要你做什么。故事：抓人物、事件、结局，注意时间顺序词。

items: Email: 'Can you bring the report tomorrow?'（意图：请带报告）
Story: First she lost the key. Then she found it under the sofa.

explanation.text: 读邮件问「对方要什么」，读故事问「发生了什么、为什么」。

activity.prompt: 用一句话概括一个短故事的情节。
activity.sampleAnswer: She lost her key, but she found it under the sofa.

questions.prompt: 读邮件最重要的是？
读故事要抓？
表示顺序的标记词是？
故事的结局就是「最后发生了什么」（结局 / ending）

nodes.title: 读懂文章与故事
nodes.organizer: B1 阅读读「结构化的真实文本」：新闻短文、说明文、叙事故事——抓主线、认信号词、猜生词。

explanation.text: 策略：标题与首段定主旨；but / how ever 后是重点；用上下文与词根猜生词；区分事实与观点。

items: Headline: City to expand bike lanes by 2027 — 主旨在标题。
However, critics say the plan is too costly.
un + known → unknown 由已知词根猜词。
First, mix the eggs. Then add the flour.

explanation.text: 生词三个「不过问」：不影响主旨的、能猜的、重复出现的先记符号跳过。

activity.prompt: 读一条短新闻，用一句话写下主旨 + 一个作者观点。
activity.sampleAnswer: 主旨：city plans new bike lanes; 观点：critics think it costs too much.

questions.prompt: 快速抓一篇新闻主旨先看：
However, …' 之后通常是：
options: 与上文相反的重点信息

questions.prompt: 遇到生词的最佳策略：
un + known = ___（写英文词）

nodes.title: 读懂论证性文本
nodes.organizer: B2 读「观点的战场」：立场、论据、反方、结论。议论文的四件套一眼拆解。

explanation.text: 识别立场（The author argues that…）、论据（because / due to）、让步（Admittedly / While it is true…）、结论（Therefore / Overall）；区分作者观点与引用观点。

items: Admittedly, remote work weakens team bonds. Nevertheless, productivity data suggest otherwise.
Critics claim X; however, the evidence points to Y.
Therefore, the policy should be phased in gradually.
According to a 2023 study…（引用观点 ≠ 作者观点）

explanation.text: Admittedly / While it is true 之后必有 but / nevertheless——让步是反弹的准备动作。

activity.prompt: 读一篇短评论，写出作者立场 + 一条让步 + 结论。
activity.sampleAnswer: 立场：支持远程办公；让步：承认协作减弱；结论：应逐步推行。

questions.prompt: 'Admittedly…' 后面通常紧跟：
'According to a study…' 的观点属于：
'Therefore' 引出的通常是：
找让步信号词：A___edly, the plan is costly.

nodes.title: 读懂复杂文本与隐含立场
nodes.organizer: C1 读「言外之意」：反讽的赞词、克制的批评、留白的结论。作者的立场很少直说。

explanation.text: 隐含立场：interesting choice（未必是夸）、a brave decision（可能指鲁莽）、not without merit（有保留的肯定）；语域与文体线索（正式 = 严肃、口语 = 轻佻）。

items: It's a bold strategy — time will tell.（怀疑）
The report is not without merit, though the methodology raises questions.
One might argue that the data was… curated.（暗指操纵）
A 'temporary' measure, now in its tenth year.（反讽）

explanation.text: C1 判断题：把「字面意思」和「作者其实想说什么」分开写下来，再选答案。

activity.prompt: 读一句书评 A fascinating book — if you enjoy being confused.，写出作者真实态度。
activity.sampleAnswer: 表面称赞，实际暗讽内容混乱，持批评态度。

questions.prompt: 'A fascinating book — if you enjoy being confused.' 的真实态度是：
'not without merit' 表示：
questions.explanation: 双重否定 = 有保留肯定。

questions.prompt: 给 'temporary' 加引号（A 'temporary' measure）暗示：
options: 名为临时、长期沿用（反讽）

questions.prompt: One might argue the data was ___ (ed)（暗示被筛选过）.
questions.explanation: curated data 被筛选的数据。

nodes.title: 写简单句子和短段落
nodes.organizer: 写作入门：把口语里的句子写成书面语，从 3-5 句介绍自己开始。

explanation.text: 基本结构：开头总起（My name is...）+ 细节（I'm from... / I like...）+ 收尾（Nice to meet you）。

items: My name is Li Ming. I'm from Chengdu. I like playing basketball.

explanation.text: 写作 = 口语的「整理版」：句子完整、主谓宾齐全。

activity.prompt: 写一段 3-5 句的自我介绍。
activity.sampleAnswer: My name is Li Ming. I'm from Chengdu. I'm a student. I like playing basketball.

questions.prompt: 写作开头通常用？
段落由什么组成？
每句的基本结构是？
段落第一句通常表达___（总起 / 细节）

nodes.title: 写短段落描述经历和计划
nodes.organizer: 写作进阶：写短段落描述经历（过去时）和计划（将来时），段落有逻辑。

explanation.text: 经历段：Last summer I visited... 计划段：Next year I'm going to... 结构：总起 → 细节 2-3 句 → 收尾。

items: Last summer I visited Beijing. I went to the Great Wall. It was amazing!
Next year I'm going to learn French.

explanation.text: 写段落 = 总起 + 细节 + 收尾，时态全文一致。

activity.prompt: 写一段 3 句的「我的计划」。
activity.sampleAnswer: Next year I'm going to learn English. I will practice every day. I hope to pass the exam.

questions.prompt: 描述经历用哪种时态？
描述计划用？
questions.explanation: 计划用 be going to / will。

questions.prompt: 段落顺序一般是？
Next year I'm going to ___ (learn / learned) French.（动词原形）

nodes.title: 写连贯的短文
nodes.organizer: 从句子到「一段话」：连接词把观点串成线（and / but / because / so / first / then）。B1 写作的目标是「读起来是一段」。

explanation.text: 基本衔接：because / so（因果）、but（转折）、first / then / finally（顺序）；一条段落线：观点 → 原因 → 例子。

items: I love cycling because it keeps me fit.
It was raining, so we stayed in.
First we packed, then we left.
I'd like to visit Japan one day and try ramen there.

explanation.text: 写完读一遍：每个句子和上一句之间有没有「桥」？没有就补 because / so / then。

activity.prompt: 用 because / so / but 写三句关于你周末的话。
activity.sampleAnswer: I was tired, so I stayed home, but I still finished my book.

questions.prompt: It was late, ___ we took a taxi.
I stayed home ___ I was tired.
正确的顺序词组：
I love winter ___ I can go skiing.（表示原因）

nodes.title: 写议论文与报告
nodes.organizer: B2 写作的四大件：立场明确、段落清晰（主题句）、衔接多样（however / furthermore）、让步反驳（Admittedly… however…）。

explanation.text: 议论文骨架：引言（立场）→ 论点段 ×2（topic sentence + evidence）→ 让步段 → 结论（重申 + 建议）；报告骨架：目的 → 发现 → 结论 → 建议。

items: This essay argues that cities should invest in cycling infrastructure.
Admittedly, the initial cost is high; however, the health benefits outweigh it.
The survey reveals a clear preference for flexible hours.
It is therefore recommended that the trial be extended.

explanation.text: 每段第一句 = 该段广告：读者只读每段首句也应能看懂全文脉络。

activity.prompt: 写一个议论文开头段（两句：背景 + 立场）。
activity.sampleAnswer: Remote work has become the norm. This essay argues that companies should adopt a hybrid model.

questions.prompt: 议论文让步段常用结构：
报告中 'It is therefore recommended that…' 出现在：
哪句适合作段落主题句？
options: Flexible hours improve productivity in three ways.

questions.prompt: 写报告的目的陈述：The aim of this ___ is to evaluate the trial.

nodes.title: 文体与精准表达
nodes.organizer: C2 写作的两个维度：精准（一词一字之差）与文体（audience awareness）。让每个词都「非它不可」。

explanation.text: 精准替换：show → demonstrate / indicate / suggest（按证据强度选）；名词化与信息压缩；文体一致：学术不用缩写（do not 而非 don't）、避免口语化（a lot of → considerable）。

items: The data suggest a modest correlation.（弱于 prove）
The implementation of the reform was delayed.（名词化压缩）
We do not accept late submissions.（正式）
Considerable evidence supports the claim.（vs a lot of）

explanation.text: C2 校对三问：这个词有没有更准的？这句能不能更紧？这语域一致吗？

activity.prompt: 把 Lots of people think this idea is really good 改成正式学术体。
activity.sampleAnswer: Many commentators consider this proposal highly effective.

questions.prompt: 证据不足时用哪个动词最严谨？
学术文体应避免：
options: 缩写（don't）与口语化（a lot of）

questions.prompt: 'considerable evidence' 相比 'a lot of evidence'：
The findings ___ a possible link.（按证据强度选最弱动词）
